items.title: 訊舟日本新專案2027首季啟動出貨 短期審慎應對料件漲價與AI排擠
items.title_en: Xunzhou launches new Japan project shipments in Q1 2027, adopts cautious short‑term approach to component price hikes and AI displacement
paras: 網通廠訊舟(3047-TW)今(11)日召開線上法人說明會，訊舟表示，受到傳統網通採購節奏放緩、關鍵零組件價格飆漲，以及去年高基期影響，上半年營運表現承壓，不過隨著日本新專案研發進度明確，預計將於2027年第一季重新恢復出貨，為營運注入新動能。
訊舟發言人廖若穎指出，市場資源與資本支出持續往AI領域集中，對傳統網通市場需求與客戶下單節奏帶來挑戰，同時原物料與關鍵零組件價格上揚，也對產品成本與毛利率帶來壓力，因此公司對短期營運維持審慎看待。
日本市場方面，雖然近兩年面臨日圓偏弱與原物料成本上升的雙重壓力，但目前日本央行採取漸進式升息政策，日圓走勢相對前期穩定，有助於終端採購信心恢復。訊舟在日本市場已確定部分專案可依時程於2027年第一季出貨，能見度相對明確，目前亦有多個新專案持續洽談中。
回顧上半年財務表現，由於去年同期日本客戶集中出貨且產品組合毛利較佳，加上子公司康全電訊去年首季有印度客戶大單挹注，今年相關出貨減少，導致集團上半年整體營收較去年同期下滑。
在毛利率部分，受到2025年第四季以來全球電子供應鏈面臨的原物料上漲壓力，包括記憶體價格飆升、銅箔基板與被動元件等關鍵材料成本顯著墊高，不可避免地壓抑了上半年的毛利率表現。
為因應原物料價格大幅波動，訊舟積極與客戶溝通並預測未來訂單量，提前採取策略性備貨措施。此舉帶動集團存貨較去年底增加10.86%，相關備貨資金需求也使短期借款以及應付票據與帳款出現相應增加。
從集團業務結構觀察，零售與商用部門上半年產品組合仍以企業用設備為主，營收占比達67.1%。受日本客戶拉貨規模不如去年集中出貨期影響，日本市場占該部門營收比重自去年的51%回落，電信部門在印度專案結束後，營收占集團整體比重降至13.6%。
面對整體產業變遷，訊舟除落實既有網通事業與成本管控外，亦持續將無線連網技術與硬體整合能力延伸至AIoT與其他新興應用。集團透過布局截創數位與成服科技等關係企業，切入無線傳輸解決方案及物聯網遠端智能環控領域，期盼透過跨產業應用拓展，降低對單一網通景氣循環的依賴。
paras_en: Xunzhou (3047‑TW) held an online institutional briefing today (Nov 11). The company said that due to a slowdown in traditional networking procurement cycles, soaring prices of key components, and the impact of last year’s high‑base effect, its first‑half operating performance was under pressure. However, with the development schedule of a new Japan project now clear, shipments are expected to resume in the first quarter of 2027, providing fresh momentum for operations.

Spokesperson Liao Ruo‑ying noted that market resources and capital expenditures continue to shift toward AI, posing challenges to demand and order pacing in the traditional networking market. At the same time, rising raw‑material and key component prices are pressuring product costs and gross margins, so the company remains cautious about short‑term operations.

Regarding Japan, although the market has faced a weak yen and higher raw‑material costs over the past two years, the Bank of Japan’s gradual rate‑hiking policy has kept the yen relatively stable recently, helping restore end‑user procurement confidence. Xunzhou has confirmed that certain projects in Japan can ship on schedule in Q1 2027, giving the outlook clearer visibility, and several other new projects are still under discussion.

Reviewing H1 financial performance, the group’s revenue fell year‑over‑year because last year’s shipments to Japanese customers were concentrated and yielded higher product‑mix margins, and because its subsidiary Kangquan Telecom’s large Indian order in Q1 last year did not recur this year, reducing related shipments.

On gross margin, the pressure from rising raw‑material costs that have affected the global electronics supply chain since Q4 2025—such as soaring memory prices and higher costs for copper‑foil substrates and passive components—inevitably suppressed H1 margin performance.

To cope with volatile raw‑material prices, Xunzhou has been actively communicating with customers and forecasting future order volumes, taking proactive strategic inventory‑building measures. This led to group inventory rising 10.86% versus year‑end, and the associated funding needs caused short‑term borrowings and payable notes and accounts to increase accordingly.

From a business‑structure perspective, the retail and commercial segment’s product mix in H1 remained enterprise‑focused, accounting for 67.1% of revenue. Because Japanese customers did not pull as much volume as during last year’s concentrated shipment period, Japan’s share of this segment fell from 51% last year, and after the Indian project ended, the telecom segment’s contribution to total group revenue dropped to 13.6%.

Facing overall industry shifts, Xunzhou not only continues to strengthen its existing networking business and cost control but also extends its wireless connectivity and hardware integration capabilities to AIoT and other emerging applications. Through investments in affiliates such as Zhe Chuang Digital and Chengfu Technology, the group is entering wireless transmission solutions and remote IoT smart‑environment control fields, hoping cross‑industry applications will reduce reliance on a single networking cycle.

items.title: 美國關稅政策懸而未決 全球銅價迎6月以來首次單周下跌
items.title_en: U.S. Tariff Policy Remains Uncertain, Global Copper Prices See First Weekly Decline Since June
paras: 由於白宮尚未針對精煉銅進口關稅作出最終決定，引發市場對高金屬價格恐推升國內製造業成本的疑慮，全球銅價呈現劇烈波動。在倫敦市場周四(10日)自歷史新高大幅回落 3.6% 後，銅價走向自今年 6 月以來的首次單周下跌，整周累計下跌 0.6%。
截至新加坡時間周五下午 2 點 43 分，倫敦金屬交易所(LME)基準銅期貨小幅回升 0.6% 至每噸 14,321.50 美元。 同日，銅的現貨與3個月期貨價差來到 10 美元，使前一日看漲的現貨溢價格局有所收窄。
關稅政策的不確定性同時重創了礦業類股，銅生產商 Freeport-McMoRan 與 Teck Resources 股價急挫約 7%，使 Freeport 高達 1,000 億美元的估值再次受到市場審視。
在此之前，銅交易商寄望於川普政府若實施進口關稅，將推升美國本土價格，因而已將數十萬噸的銅轉運至美國市場以期套利。此外，資料中心與再生能源帶動的需求樂觀預期，加上主要礦場的供應受阻，也是持續支持投資人買盤的原因。
針對近期走勢，研調機構 BMI警告，近期的價格飆漲已超越基本面可合理支持的水準，市場關稅不不確定性居高不下。 此外，美國即將公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)數據仍是市場焦點，若通膨升溫強化聯準會升息預期，將對無收益的銅價構成壓力。
在其他金屬方面，周五鋁價與鋅價小幅走高，錫價則下跌 0.8%。
paras_en: Because the White House has not yet made a final decision on import tariffs for refined copper, the market is worried that high metal prices could push up domestic manufacturing costs. As a result, global copper prices have been extremely volatile. After falling sharply 3.6% from a historic high on Thursday (the 10th) in the London market, copper embarked on its first weekly decline since June, slipping a total of 0.6% for the week.

By 2:43 p.m. Singapore time on Friday, the London Metal Exchange (LME) benchmark copper futures had edged up 0.6% to $14,321.50 per metric ton. On the same day, the spread between spot copper and the three‑month contract narrowed to $10, tightening the previously bullish spot‑premium scenario.

The uncertainty over tariff policy also hammered mining stocks, with copper producers Freeport‑McMoRan and Teck Resources seeing their shares plunge about 7%, putting Freeport’s $100 billion market valuation back under market scrutiny.

Earlier, copper traders had hoped that a Trump‑era import tariff would lift U.S. domestic prices, prompting them to ship hundreds of thousands of tonnes of copper to the U.S. market for arbitrage. In addition, optimistic demand outlooks from data centers and renewable energy, together with supply constraints at major mines, have continued to support buying interest from investors.

Regarding the recent price action, research firm BMI warned that the recent price surge has exceeded levels that fundamentals can reasonably support, and that tariff uncertainty remains high. Moreover, the upcoming U.S. consumer price index (CPI) release remains a market focus; if inflation heats up and strengthens expectations of Fed rate hikes, it will put pressure on the non‑yielding copper price.
In other metals, Friday saw modest gains in aluminium and zinc prices, while tin fell 0.8%.

items.title: 〈台幣〉買匯避險升溫 爆量貶值9分收31.638元
items.title_en: TWD Hedging Demand Rises, Massive Volume, Depreciates 0.09 to Close at 31.638
paras: 在國際油價攀升、美國升息壓力升溫的衝擊下，台北股匯市重挫，買匯避險力道湧現，新台幣今(11)日全日處貶值態勢，最低一度逼近31.7元價位，終場收在31.638元，貶值9分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值暴出29.38億美元天量。
新台幣今日以31.58元、貶值3.2分開出後，越走越低，午盤後開出全日最低價31.698元，買匯力道相當強勁，收盤前一小時貶值壓力才緩步收斂，高低價差1.18角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元反而強彈超過0.4%，日元升值0.2%，泰銖、人民幣和星元微幅升值，新台幣最弱勢，收貶0.29%。
元大投顧分析，美國8月PPI年增5.4%、月增0.4%，高於市場預期，也推高各界對美國升息的預期，同時，美國10年期公債殖利率向上逼近5%關卡，也加深市場避險情緒。
paras_en: Amid rising international oil prices and mounting pressure for U.S. rate hikes, Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets suffered sharp declines, prompting a surge in demand for TWD hedging. The New Taiwan dollar was on a depreciation trend throughout the day, briefly approaching the 31.7 per dollar level, and ultimately closed at 31.638, down 0.09. Taipei forex brokers reported a record‑high turnover of USD 2.938 billion.

The TWD opened today at 31.58, down 0.032, and kept sliding lower, reaching a intraday low of 31.698 after the lunch break. Buying pressure was strong, and only in the final hour before the close did the depreciation pressure ease slightly, resulting in a high‑low spread of 0.118.

Looking at other major Asian currencies, the Korean won actually rallied more than 0.4%, the Japanese yen appreciated 0.2%, and the Thai baht, Chinese yuan, and Singapore dollar showed modest gains, while the TWD was the weakest, ending down 0.29%.

Yuanta Securities analysis notes that U.S. August PPI rose 5.4% year‑over‑year and 0.4% month‑over‑month, exceeding market expectations and fueling expectations of further U.S. rate hikes. At the same time, the yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury approached the 5% threshold, deepening market risk‑aversion.

items.title: AI股波動放大，巴菲特卻加碼布局這檔!
items.title_en: AI Stock Volatility Amplifies, Yet Buffett Increases His Stake in This Stock!
paras: 台股短線仍處於高檔震盪，PPI升溫、CPI與聯準會升息預期，將持續牽動市場情緒，若美債殖利率再往上突破，指數仍可能回測支撐。不過台積電營收維持強勁，AI需求與產業趨勢並未改變，因此修正不必過度恐慌。操作上持續降低高本益比、漲多個股部位，提高現金水位，等待市場拉回後，再布局基本面強勁的AI與半導體主流股。另一方面，油價上漲也可能重新推升通膨，使市場對未來利率政策的預期產生變化。這些因素，都可能成為台股後續波動放大的催化劑。

從近三個月ETF表現來看，市場其實已經出現明顯分化。6月1日至8月31日，市值型元大台灣50（0050）含息報酬僅1.32%，主動式ETF方面，主動統一台股增長(00981A)下跌5.36%，而主動復華金融股息(00998A)則逆勢上漲13.96%；高股息ETF則是國泰永續高息(00878)上漲6.92%、群益台灣精選高息(00919)上漲10.12%。這組數據反映出，當市場從全面上漲轉向高檔震盪，資金開始重新尋找不同產業、不同風險因子的避風港。對已經持有台股的人來說，最大的問題不是「要不要繼續投資」，而是當科技股波動加大時，投資組合是否還有其他可以提供支撐的資產。

近幾年台股ETF最大的結構性變化，就是AI與半導體在指數中的權重快速提高。以0050為例，AI相關產業占比超過七成，金融股占比僅約8%；主動式ETF中的00981A，成分股也幾乎全面集中在AI與科技族群；高股息ETF雖然看似分散，但00878科技股占比約51%。這種結構在AI高速成長時期確實具有強大的上漲爆發力，但當科技股估值已經位於高檔，投資人的風險也同步集中。只要AI資本支出出現疑慮、企業獲利不如預期，或者美債殖利率快速上升壓縮高本益比公司的估值，科技股就可能出現同步修正，而ETF因成分股集中於科技股，受修正影響的機會則被放大

這也是目前不少投資人面對的兩難：已經進場的人，漲多之後捨不得賣，卻又不敢在高檔繼續追；還沒有進場的人，看到市場快速輪動，又不知道下一個應該買什麼。當「所有ETF都在買AI」成為市場共識時，真正需要思考的反而不是還有哪些科技股可以追，而是投資組合是不是太過集中在同一個風險因子。當科技股估值偏高、盤勢震盪加劇，金融股的防禦價值就逐漸浮現。這不只發生在台股，也反映全球資產配置的變化。價值投資的重要精神之一，就是當市場熱門產業估值過高時，尋找具備實質獲利、穩定現金流與合理估值的產業。
因此，部分台股主動式ETF在市場震盪期間，開始增加大型金融股部位，背後邏輯並不難理解。銀行、保險、交易所及資產管理公司等金融企業，收入來源相較純科技成長股更加多元，除了利息收入，也包括手續費、交易佣金、資產管理與保險等現金流，在市場震盪時可以提供不同於科技股的投資因子。
就連波克夏的最新持倉，也透露出類似訊號。金融類股在其美股投資組合中仍占接近35%，高居主要產業配置之首。當全球股市處在高檔，投資組合的重點便不再只是追求最高成長，而是如何降低單一產業回檔所造成的資產傷害。

這也是00998A值得關注的原因。00998A為全台首檔全球金融主動式ETF，不強制追蹤單一指數，而是由經理人主動挑選全球具競爭力、高獲利與穩定配息能力的金融龍頭，投資範圍涵蓋歐美、日本大型銀行、保險公司、交易所，並搭配部分Fintech標的。若從分散風險的角度來看，全球金融類股與科技股歷史相關係數約0.58，並非完全同步，因此當AI科技股因估值修正而震盪時，金融股有機會發揮資產平滑效果。此外，並透過主動式操作，依照利率、景氣與金融市場環境調整持股。相較被動ETF必須依照指數權重持有成分股，主動式ETF可以在企業基本面轉弱時降低持股，投資彈性更高。收益方面，00998A採季配息與收益平準金機制，2026年6月首次每單位配息0.404元；最新9月每單位配息0.424元，以9月1日市價17.83元計算，年化配息率約9.52%。
因此，00998A真正吸引人的地方，不只是接近一成的現金流，而是提供了台股科技ETF之外的另一個產業配置選項。當AI仍是市場長期主軸，科技股當然不能缺席；但在高檔震盪環境下，真正成熟的資產配置，或許不是繼續把所有資金集中在同一個方向，而是在科技成長之外，增加金融股這類具備獲利、現金流與股息支撐的資產，讓投資組合從「只追求上漲」進一步走向「兼顧防禦」。
最近這段時間，大盤明顯量縮震盪，指數看起來沒跌多少，但真正做起來其實很難。
追高容易被洗、亂換股又很容易換錯，這種盤最考驗的不是膽量，而是你到底有沒有選對產業、選對股票。

paras_en: The Taiwan market remains in high‑level oscillation in the short term; rising PPI, CPI and expectations of Fed rate hikes will continue to affect sentiment, and if U.S. Treasury yields break higher again the index could retest support. However, TSMC’s revenue stays strong and AI demand and industry trends have not changed, so there is no need for an over‑reaction in revisions. The strategy is to keep lowering positions in high‑P/E stocks, reduce exposure to over‑bought names, raise cash levels, wait for a market pull‑back, and then allocate to fundamentally solid AI and semiconductor core stocks. Meanwhile, higher oil prices could reignite inflation and alter expectations for future rate policy. These factors may all become catalysts for larger volatility in Taiwan stocks.

Looking at ETF performance over the past three months, the market has already shown clear divergence. From June 1 to August 31, the market‑cap‑weighted Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050) delivered a total return of only 1.32% including dividends. Among active ETFs, Uni‑Taiwan Growth (00981A) fell 5.36% while Uni‑Finance Dividend (00998A) rose 13.96% against the trend. High‑dividend ETFs saw Cathay Sustainable High Yield (00878) up 6.92% and Quanyi Taiwan Select High Yield (00919) up 10.12%. These figures show that as the market shifts from a broad rally to high‑level consolidation, capital begins to search for safe havens across different sectors and risk factors. For those already holding Taiwan equities, the biggest question is not “whether to keep investing” but whether the portfolio still has other assets that can provide support when tech stocks become more volatile.

In recent years the biggest structural change in Taiwan ETFs has been the rapid rise in AI and semiconductor weighting within the indices. In the 0050, AI‑related industries now account for over 70% of the basket, while financial stocks are only about 8%. In the active ETF 00981A, the constituents are almost entirely concentrated in AI and technology groups. Even the high‑dividend ETF, which appears diversified, has about 51% of its holdings in tech stocks (00878). This structure gives strong upside during AI’s high‑growth phase, but when tech valuations are already at lofty levels, investors’ risk becomes similarly concentrated. If AI capital spending is questioned, corporate earnings fall short, or U.S. Treasury yields rise sharply compressing valuations of high‑P/E companies, tech stocks could undergo a synchronized correction, and ETFs heavily weighted toward tech would feel an amplified impact.

This creates a dilemma for many investors: those already in the market are reluctant to sell after gains yet hesitant to chase higher prices; those not yet in are confused by the rapid rotation and unsure what to buy next. When the consensus becomes “all ETFs are buying AI,” the real issue is not which tech stocks to chase but whether the portfolio is overly concentrated in a single risk factor. As tech valuations stay high and market swings intensify, the defensive value of financial stocks begins to emerge. This pattern is not limited to Taiwan; it mirrors global asset‑allocation shifts. One core principle of value investing is to seek industries with real earnings, stable cash flow and reasonable valuations when hot sectors become over‑priced.

Consequently, some Taiwan active ETFs have started to increase positions in large‑cap financial stocks during market turbulence, a logic that is easy to understand. Banks, insurers, exchanges and asset‑management firms have more diversified revenue streams than pure‑play tech growth stocks, earning not only interest but also fees, commissions, asset‑management and insurance cash flows, which can provide a different investment factor when markets wobble.

Even Berkshire Hathaway’s latest holdings send a similar signal. Financial stocks still make up close to 35% of its U.S. equity portfolio, the largest sector allocation. When global equities sit at high levels, the portfolio focus shifts from chasing the highest growth to reducing the damage that a single‑industry pull‑back can cause.

items.title: 彩晶總經理陳盛中辭職 董事長焦佑麒暫代
items.title_en: Cai Jing General Manager Chen Shengzhong Resigns, Chairman Jiao Youqi Serves as Interim
paras: 面板廠彩晶(6116-TW)今(11)日公告，總經理陳盛中辭職，由董事長焦佑麒暫代；陳盛中也身兼彩晶資訊安全長，職缺則由副總經理邱博興接任。
彩晶近年積極朝高毛利、高附加價值產品轉型，加速布局車載、工控及無人機等利基型應用市場，目標明年車載產品營收比重提升至3成以上。除車載外，彩晶也積極布局工業控制、穿戴裝置與無人機應用。
此外，為提升資產使用效率及強化財務結構，彩晶4月底董事會也決議處分南科廠不動產，交易金額 43.2 億元，處分利益 21.6 億元，預計於第三季認列，處分資金將用於充實營運資金及增強未來發展動能。
彩晶8月營收9.34億元，月增7.1%、年增8%；累計前8月營收78.9億元，年增2.9%，為近3年同期最佳。
paras_en: Panel manufacturer Cai Jing (6116-TW) announced today (the 11th) that General Manager Chen Shengzhong has resigned, with Chairman Jiao Youqi temporarily assuming the role; Chen also served as the company's Chief Information Security Officer, and the vacancy will be filled by Vice President Qiu Boxing.

In recent years, Cai Jing has been actively shifting toward high‑margin, high‑value‑added products, accelerating its entry into niche markets such as automotive, industrial control and unmanned aerial vehicles, with a goal of raising the share of automotive product revenue to over 30% next year. In addition to automotive, the company is also pursuing opportunities in industrial control, wearable devices and UAV applications.

Furthermore, to improve asset utilization and strengthen its financial structure, the board approved at the end of April the disposal of real estate at its Southern Taiwan Science Park plant for a transaction amount of NT$4.32 billion, generating a disposal profit of NT$2.16 billion. The gain is expected to be recognized in the third quarter, and the proceeds will be used to bolster working capital and enhance future growth momentum.

Cai Jing reported August revenue of NT$934 million, up 7.1% month‑over‑month and 8% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$7.89 billion, a 2.9% annual increase and the best performance in the same period over the past three years.

items.title: 高房貸利率抑制買氣 美國待售房屋供應量創10年新高
items.title_en: High Mortgage Rates Damp Buying Demand as US Home Supply Hits 10‑Year High
paras: 全美待售房屋庫存量在8月攀升至10年來新高，反映出高房貸利率以及通膨與地緣政治等經濟不確定性，正持續抑制買家的購屋意願。
根據美國全國房地產經紀人協會(NAR)數據，按目前銷售速度計算，8月份市場上的房屋供應量達4.9個月，創下逾十年新高。同時，成屋銷售量單月微幅下降2%。
根據房地美(Freddie Mac)資料，30年期固定房貸平均利率升至6.76%，為2025年夏季以來的最高水準。
NAR首席經濟學家Lawrence Yun表示，充足的待售房屋供應正為買家提供更好的議價空間。然而，在薪資增長支撐下，8月房屋中位售價仍年增1.6%，至429,100美元。由於高借貸成本嚇退潛在買家，加上許多既有屋主因鎖定早期的低利率而不願換房，使美國房市長期處於凍結狀態。
市場普遍預計房市活動將繼續放緩。凱投宏觀(Capital Economics)分析師預測，2026年將是十多年來房屋銷售最為疲軟的一年，且30年期房貸利率在未來兩年內恐維持在6%以上。
房地產機構Redfin與Zillow持類似觀點，Zillow更預期年底利率將達6.79%，全美房屋銷售前景依然充滿挑戰。
paras_en: US inventory of homes for sale rose in August to a ten‑year high, reflecting that high mortgage rates and economic uncertainty from inflation and geopolitics continue to suppress buyer enthusiasm.

According to data from the National Association of Realtors (NAR), the supply of homes on the market in August equated to 4.9 months of sales at the current pace, a level not seen in over a decade, while existing‑home sales slipped slightly by 2% month‑over‑month.
Freddie Mac data show the average rate on a 30‑year fixed‑rate mortgage climbed to 6.76%, the highest since the summer of 2025.

NAR chief economist Lawrence Yun said the ample supply of homes for sale is giving buyers better negotiating power. Yet, backed by wage growth, the median home price in August still rose 1.6% year‑over‑year to $429,100. High borrowing costs are scaring off potential buyers, and many existing owners are reluctant to move because they locked in lower rates earlier, leaving the market in a prolonged freeze.

The market is broadly expected to keep slowing. Capital Economics analyst predicts 2026 will be the weakest year for home sales in more than a decade, and 30‑year mortgage rates could stay above 6% for the next two years.
Real‑estate firms Redfin and Zillow share a similar outlook; Zillow even forecasts rates reaching 6.79% by year‑end, keeping the outlook for US home sales challenging.

items.title: 全球前十大IC設計Q2營收年增73% AMD擠進前三名
items.title_en: Global Top Ten IC Designers See 73% YoY Revenue Growth in Q2, AMD Breaks Into Top Three
paras: 研調機構TrendForce今(11)日釋出最新IC設計產業研究，隨著AI相關應用擴張，GPU、CPU、ASIC、互連產品等需求攀升，帶動第二季全球前十大IC設計業者營收年增73%，突破1,414.5億美元。輝達(NVDA-US)穩居榜首、博通(AVGO-US)排名第二，超微(AMD-US)受惠CPU於代理AI應用提升，排名升至第三。高通(QCOM-US)則因手機業務走弱，退居第四名。
輝達第二季營收年增99%，近911.6億美元，於前十大業者營收占比成長至64%。除了超大型雲端服務供應商為其主要客戶，Neo Cloud客戶、主權AI、企業客戶也對營收有顯著貢獻。
TrendForce表示，輝達近期藉由擴大NVLink Fusion生態系，參與ASIC相關市場。如投資聯發科(2454-TW)以協助客製化XPU客戶加強與現有NVIDIA基礎建設互通，並為將來的車用AI領域作布局。在此之前投資邁威爾也將NVLink Fusion納入合作項目。
博通第二季營收排名第二，其協助設計的OpenAI首款ASIC、Google TPU 8i於本季開始出貨，網通業務也隨XPU同步高速成長，營收年增幅高達112%，逾188.9億美元，包含Anthropic、OpenAI等前瞻模型(frontier model)開發商在內的六大客製化晶片客戶將持續驅動其XPU需求。
第三名超微得益於代理AI時代來臨，CPU重要性再度提升，第二季營收超過115.3億美元。其資料中心CPU營收已連續五季創下新高，不斷搶占英特爾(INTC-US) X86 伺服器市占率。
高通第二季儘管手機晶片業務仍處低迷，在新一代iPhone數據機晶片的占比也下滑，但車用市場已連續23個季度保持雙位數年增，抵消部分手機業務衝擊，營收逾85億美元，近期也重返資料中心業務，加速QCT部門的多角化布局。
聯發科營收同樣受手機業務影響，為48.1億美元左右，排名第五。但該公司上修AI ASIC業務展望，預計2026年資料中心營收將超過20億美元，2028年ASIC可服務市場規模上調至800億美元。
高速增長的互連需求推升邁威爾(MRVL-US)第二季營收至26.3億美元，排名第六。其PAM4 DSP晶片領先業界，800G DSP需求強勁、1.6T DSP正快速放量；客製化業務亦與Google達成合作協議，將於2029財年帶來顯著貢獻。
瑞昱(2379-TW)第二季營收近11.9億美元，排名第七。由於預期2026下半年PC表現將更加低迷，其規劃以現有強勢IP切入server市場，如10G乙太網、server control plane交換機等。
MPS主要成長引擎來自AI相關電源管理解決方案，本季營收9.81億美元，排名第八。該公司維持產能擴充，以支撐往半導體解決方案提供商轉型所需。
聯詠(3034-TW)本季營收9.07億美元，排名第九，營收成長主因是客戶提前拉貨的動能延續。其SoC晶片營收占比已超越5成，未來持續投入Edge AI等機器視覺SoC相關應用。
OmniVision本季半導體設計營收為8.38億美元，排名第十。雖然記憶體價格影響手機、車用CIS業務，但運動相機等新興應用強勁成長，類比IC則已布局光通訊EIC，包含TIA、Driver等晶片。
paras_en: Research firm TrendForce released its latest IC design industry study today, noting that expanding AI‑related applications have boosted demand for GPUs, CPUs, ASICs and interconnect products, driving a 73% year‑over‑year increase in Q2 revenue for the world’s top ten IC designers to a record $141.45 billion. NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) remains at the top, Broadcom (AVGO‑US) is second, and AMD (AMD‑US) climbs to third thanks to higher CPU sales for AI workloads. Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) falls to fourth as its handset business weakens.

NVIDIA’s Q2 revenue jumped 99% to about $91.16 billion, raising its share of the top‑ten designers’ total revenue to 64%. In addition to hyperscale cloud providers, its Neo Cloud, sovereign AI and enterprise customers also contributed significantly.

TrendForce said NVIDIA has recently expanded its NVLink Fusion ecosystem to enter the ASIC market, investing in MediaTek (2454‑TW) to help custom XPU customers integrate with existing NVIDIA infrastructure and to lay groundwork for automotive AI. Earlier, it invested in Marvell, also incorporating NVLink Fusion into joint projects.

Broadcom posted the second‑largest Q2 revenue, helped by the OpenAI‑designed ASIC and Google’s TPU 8i, which began shipping this quarter. Its networking business grew rapidly alongside XPU demand, delivering a 112% YoY increase to over $18.89 billion, with six custom‑chip customers such as Anthropic and OpenAI driving further XPU sales.

AMD, now third, benefited from the AI‑driven resurgence of CPUs, posting Q2 revenue of more than $11.53 billion. Its data‑center CPU sales have hit new highs for five consecutive quarters, steadily eroding Intel’s (INTC‑US) X86 server market share.

Despite a slump in its handset chip segment and a lower share of the next‑generation iPhone modem market, Qualcomm’s Q2 revenue topped $8.5 billion, helped by a 23‑quarter streak of double‑digit growth in automotive chips that offset some handset weakness. The company also returned to the data‑center arena, accelerating diversification in its QCT unit.

MediaTek’s Q2 revenue, also hit by the handset slowdown, was around $4.81 billion, placing it fifth. The firm raised its AI‑ASIC outlook, projecting data‑center revenue to exceed $2 billion by 2026 and expanding its 2028 ASIC addressable market to $80 billion.

Rapid growth in interconnect demand lifted Marvell’s (MRVL‑US) Q2 revenue to $2.63 billion, ranking sixth. Its PAM4 DSP chips lead the market, with strong 800 Gbps DSP demand and fast‑growing 1.6 Tbps DSP volumes; a custom‑chip partnership with Google is set to deliver significant contributions in fiscal 2029.

Realtek (2379‑TW) posted Q2 revenue of about $1.19 billion, ranking seventh. Anticipating a weaker second half of 2026 for PCs, the company plans to leverage its strong IP portfolio to enter the server market with products such as 10‑Gb Ethernet and server control‑plane switches.

MPS’s main growth driver is AI‑related power‑management solutions, delivering Q2 revenue of $981 million and ranking eighth. The company continues capacity expansion to support its transition toward a semiconductor‑solutions provider.

Novatek (3034‑TW) recorded Q2 revenue of $907 million, ranking ninth, with growth driven by customers pulling forward orders. Its SoC revenue now exceeds 50% of total sales, and it will keep investing in Edge AI and machine‑vision SoC applications.

OmniVision’s semiconductor‑design revenue for the quarter was $838 million, ranking tenth. While memory‑price pressure hurts its mobile and automotive CIS businesses, strong growth in action‑camera and other emerging applications offsets the impact, and its analog IC line is expanding into optical‑communication EICs such as TIAs and drivers.

items.title: 訊舟日本新專案2027首季啟動出貨 短期審慎應對料件漲價與AI排擠
items.title_en: Xunzhou launches new Japan project shipments in Q1 2027, adopts cautious short‑term approach to component price hikes and AI displacement
paras: 網通廠訊舟(3047-TW)今(11)日召開線上法人說明會，訊舟表示，受到傳統網通採購節奏放緩、關鍵零組件價格飆漲，以及去年高基期影響，上半年營運表現承壓，不過隨著日本新專案研發進度明確，預計將於2027年第一季重新恢復出貨，為營運注入新動能。
訊舟發言人廖若穎指出，市場資源與資本支出持續往AI領域集中，對傳統網通市場需求與客戶下單節奏帶來挑戰，同時原物料與關鍵零組件價格上揚，也對產品成本與毛利率帶來壓力，因此公司對短期營運維持審慎看待。
日本市場方面，雖然近兩年面臨日圓偏弱與原物料成本上升的雙重壓力，但目前日本央行採取漸進式升息政策，日圓走勢相對前期穩定，有助於終端採購信心恢復。訊舟在日本市場已確定部分專案可依時程於2027年第一季出貨，能見度相對明確，目前亦有多個新專案持續洽談中。
回顧上半年財務表現，由於去年同期日本客戶集中出貨且產品組合毛利較佳，加上子公司康全電訊去年首季有印度客戶大單挹注，今年相關出貨減少，導致集團上半年整體營收較去年同期下滑。
在毛利率部分，受到2025年第四季以來全球電子供應鏈面臨的原物料上漲壓力，包括記憶體價格飆升、銅箔基板與被動元件等關鍵材料成本顯著墊高，不可避免地壓抑了上半年的毛利率表現。
為因應原物料價格大幅波動，訊舟積極與客戶溝通並預測未來訂單量，提前採取策略性備貨措施。此舉帶動集團存貨較去年底增加10.86%，相關備貨資金需求也使短期借款以及應付票據與帳款出現相應增加。
從集團業務結構觀察，零售與商用部門上半年產品組合仍以企業用設備為主，營收占比達67.1%。受日本客戶拉貨規模不如去年集中出貨期影響，日本市場占該部門營收比重自去年的51%回落，電信部門在印度專案結束後，營收占集團整體比重降至13.6%。
面對整體產業變遷，訊舟除落實既有網通事業與成本管控外，亦持續將無線連網技術與硬體整合能力延伸至AIoT與其他新興應用。集團透過布局截創數位與成服科技等關係企業，切入無線傳輸解決方案及物聯網遠端智能環控領域，期盼透過跨產業應用拓展，降低對單一網通景氣循環的依賴。
paras_en: Xunzhou (3047‑TW) held an online institutional briefing today (Nov 11). The company said that due to a slowdown in traditional networking procurement cycles, soaring prices of key components, and the impact of last year’s high‑base effect, its first‑half operating performance was under pressure. However, with the development schedule of a new Japan project now clear, shipments are expected to resume in the first quarter of 2027, providing fresh momentum for operations.

Spokesperson Liao Ruo‑ying noted that market resources and capital expenditures continue to shift toward AI, posing challenges to demand and order pacing in the traditional networking market. At the same time, rising raw‑material and key component prices are pressuring product costs and gross margins, so the company remains cautious about short‑term operations.

Regarding Japan, although the market has faced a weak yen and higher raw‑material costs over the past two years, the Bank of Japan’s gradual rate‑hiking policy has kept the yen relatively stable recently, helping restore end‑user procurement confidence. Xunzhou has confirmed that certain projects in Japan can ship on schedule in Q1 2027, giving the outlook clearer visibility, and several other new projects are still under discussion.

Reviewing H1 financial performance, the group’s revenue fell year‑over‑year because last year’s shipments to Japanese customers were concentrated and yielded higher product‑mix margins, and because its subsidiary Kangquan Telecom’s large Indian order in Q1 last year did not recur this year, reducing related shipments.

On gross margin, the pressure from rising raw‑material costs that have affected the global electronics supply chain since Q4 2025—such as soaring memory prices and higher costs for copper‑foil substrates and passive components—inevitably suppressed H1 margin performance.

To cope with volatile raw‑material prices, Xunzhou has been actively communicating with customers and forecasting future order volumes, taking proactive strategic inventory‑building measures. This led to group inventory rising 10.86% versus year‑end, and the associated funding needs caused short‑term borrowings and payable notes and accounts to increase accordingly.

From a business‑structure perspective, the retail and commercial segment’s product mix in H1 remained enterprise‑focused, accounting for 67.1% of revenue. Because Japanese customers did not pull as much volume as during last year’s concentrated shipment period, Japan’s share of this segment fell from 51% last year, and after the Indian project ended, the telecom segment’s contribution to total group revenue dropped to 13.6%.

Facing overall industry shifts, Xunzhou not only continues to strengthen its existing networking business and cost control but also extends its wireless connectivity and hardware integration capabilities to AIoT and other emerging applications. Through investments in affiliates such as Zhe Chuang Digital and Chengfu Technology, the group is entering wireless transmission solutions and remote IoT smart‑environment control fields, hoping cross‑industry applications will reduce reliance on a single networking cycle.

items.title: 新安東京海上產險對標金管會AI轉型政策 從服務智慧化到企業風險賦能
items.title_en: Shin An Tokio Marine Insurance Aligns with Financial Supervisory Commission AI Transformation Policy, From Service Smartification to Enterprise Risk Enablement
paras: 金管會揭示保險監理三大方向，首重「推動AI科技轉型並落實AI指引與資料治理」。新安東京海上產險率先於2018年開始布局AI賦能於保險服務，更深化AI數位技術於核保理賠的資料驗證、風險評估及客戶服務等應用，在提升營運效率與優化客戶體驗的同時，亦兼顧資訊安全、個人資料保護及風險管理，為保險服務智慧化樹立標竿。

新安東京海上產險秉持「負責任地創新」精神，將AI治理架構完整融入保險服務生命週期，並建構國際級標準為資訊治理基石，自2017年起導入「ISO 27001資訊安全管理系統」及「ISO 27701隱私資訊管理系統」並取得雙驗證有效續評。在此穩固基礎上，展現在導入語音轉文字(Speech To Text，STT)系統，且嚴格遵循權限控管、個人資料隱碼、存取紀錄留存等管理機制，確保每一次智慧化升級均在穩健合規的數據治理框架下實踐，具體呼應金管會對金融業AI應用的監理期待。
另在核保作業具體應用上，如汽車險承保勘車作業運用AI技術輔助進行車輛辨識、藉由數位核保模型及影像辨識系統核保機制進行資料檢核、異常案件辨識及風險分析，提升整體核保品質及效率。此外，住宅火險核保系統亦減少人工填寫、補件及查核作業時間，原本一核保案件需花費45分鐘大幅縮短至5分鐘，投保流程更加便捷友善。
新安東京海上進一步以AI賦能擴展至企業風險管理服務，前後舉辦兩場「企業風險管理研討會」，邀請AI領域的顧問及專家分享，協助企業客戶在面對人工智慧技術迅速發展時，如何重塑風險管理模式及掌握最新風險趨勢以強化營運韌性，助力客戶從「事後補償」走向「事前預防」。
展望未來，新安東京海上將不斷前行，持續導入AI Agent查勘平台、AI風險提醒等風險評估機制，透過智慧化損害防阻服務協助企業因應新興風險與氣候變遷挑戰，具體實踐保險業風險管理者的核心價值。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission disclosed three major directions for insurance supervision, emphasizing "promoting AI technology transformation and implementing AI guidelines and data governance." Shin An Tokio Marine Insurance was the first to begin AI empowerment in insurance services in 2018, deepening AI digital technology applications in underwriting, claims data verification, risk assessment, and customer service. While enhancing operational efficiency and optimizing customer experience, it also addresses information security, personal data protection, and risk management, setting a benchmark for intelligent insurance services.

Guided by the spirit of "responsible innovation," Shin An Tokio Marine fully integrates an AI governance framework into the insurance service lifecycle and builds an internationally‑level standard as the foundation for information governance. Since 2017 it has adopted ISO 27001 for information security management and ISO 27701 for privacy information management, obtaining dual certifications with ongoing renewal. On this solid base it has deployed a Speech‑to‑Text (STT) system, strictly adhering to access controls, personal data masking, and audit‑log retention mechanisms, ensuring every smart upgrade is carried out within a robust, compliant data‑governance framework, directly responding to the regulator’s expectations for AI use in finance.

In underwriting, AI is applied concretely—for auto insurance, AI assists vehicle identification during on‑site inspections, and digital underwriting models combined with image‑recognition systems verify data, detect anomalies, and analyze risk, boosting overall underwriting quality and efficiency. Likewise, the residential fire‑insurance underwriting system reduces manual entry, supplemental documentation, and review time, cutting the processing time for a case from 45 minutes to just 5 minutes, making the application process far more convenient and user‑friendly.

Shin An Tokio Marine further extends AI empowerment to corporate risk‑management services, hosting two "Enterprise Risk Management Seminars" that invite AI consultants and experts to share insights. These events help corporate clients reshape risk‑management models and stay abreast of emerging risk trends amid rapid AI development, strengthening operational resilience and moving clients from "post‑event compensation" to "pre‑event prevention."

Looking ahead, Shin An Tokio Marine will continue advancing, introducing AI‑driven inspection platforms, AI risk‑alert mechanisms, and other risk‑assessment tools. Through intelligent loss‑prevention services, it aims to help enterprises tackle emerging risks and climate‑change challenges, concretely embodying the core value of insurers as risk managers.

items.title: 〈台幣〉買匯避險升溫 爆量貶值9分收31.638元
items.title_en: TWD Hedging Demand Rises, Massive Volume, Depreciates 0.09 to Close at 31.638
paras: 在國際油價攀升、美國升息壓力升溫的衝擊下，台北股匯市重挫，買匯避險力道湧現，新台幣今(11)日全日處貶值態勢，最低一度逼近31.7元價位，終場收在31.638元，貶值9分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值暴出29.38億美元天量。
新台幣今日以31.58元、貶值3.2分開出後，越走越低，午盤後開出全日最低價31.698元，買匯力道相當強勁，收盤前一小時貶值壓力才緩步收斂，高低價差1.18角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元反而強彈超過0.4%，日元升值0.2%，泰銖、人民幣和星元微幅升值，新台幣最弱勢，收貶0.29%。
元大投顧分析，美國8月PPI年增5.4%、月增0.4%，高於市場預期，也推高各界對美國升息的預期，同時，美國10年期公債殖利率向上逼近5%關卡，也加深市場避險情緒。
paras_en: Amid rising international oil prices and mounting pressure for U.S. rate hikes, Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets suffered sharp declines, prompting a surge in demand for TWD hedging. The New Taiwan dollar was on a depreciation trend throughout the day, briefly approaching the 31.7 per dollar level, and ultimately closed at 31.638, down 0.09. Taipei forex brokers reported a record‑high turnover of USD 2.938 billion.

The TWD opened today at 31.58, down 0.032, and kept sliding lower, reaching a intraday low of 31.698 after the lunch break. Buying pressure was strong, and only in the final hour before the close did the depreciation pressure ease slightly, resulting in a high‑low spread of 0.118.

Looking at other major Asian currencies, the Korean won actually rallied more than 0.4%, the Japanese yen appreciated 0.2%, and the Thai baht, Chinese yuan, and Singapore dollar showed modest gains, while the TWD was the weakest, ending down 0.29%.

Yuanta Securities analysis notes that U.S. August PPI rose 5.4% year‑over‑year and 0.4% month‑over‑month, exceeding market expectations and fueling expectations of further U.S. rate hikes. At the same time, the yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury approached the 5% threshold, deepening market risk‑aversion.

items.title: AI股波動放大，巴菲特卻加碼布局這檔!
items.title_en: AI Stock Volatility Amplifies, Yet Buffett Increases His Stake in This Stock!
paras: 台股短線仍處於高檔震盪，PPI升溫、CPI與聯準會升息預期，將持續牽動市場情緒，若美債殖利率再往上突破，指數仍可能回測支撐。不過台積電營收維持強勁，AI需求與產業趨勢並未改變，因此修正不必過度恐慌。操作上持續降低高本益比、漲多個股部位，提高現金水位，等待市場拉回後，再布局基本面強勁的AI與半導體主流股。另一方面，油價上漲也可能重新推升通膨，使市場對未來利率政策的預期產生變化。這些因素，都可能成為台股後續波動放大的催化劑。

從近三個月ETF表現來看，市場其實已經出現明顯分化。6月1日至8月31日，市值型元大台灣50（0050）含息報酬僅1.32%，主動式ETF方面，主動統一台股增長(00981A)下跌5.36%，而主動復華金融股息(00998A)則逆勢上漲13.96%；高股息ETF則是國泰永續高息(00878)上漲6.92%、群益台灣精選高息(00919)上漲10.12%。這組數據反映出，當市場從全面上漲轉向高檔震盪，資金開始重新尋找不同產業、不同風險因子的避風港。對已經持有台股的人來說，最大的問題不是「要不要繼續投資」，而是當科技股波動加大時，投資組合是否還有其他可以提供支撐的資產。

近幾年台股ETF最大的結構性變化，就是AI與半導體在指數中的權重快速提高。以0050為例，AI相關產業占比超過七成，金融股占比僅約8%；主動式ETF中的00981A，成分股也幾乎全面集中在AI與科技族群；高股息ETF雖然看似分散，但00878科技股占比約51%。這種結構在AI高速成長時期確實具有強大的上漲爆發力，但當科技股估值已經位於高檔，投資人的風險也同步集中。只要AI資本支出出現疑慮、企業獲利不如預期，或者美債殖利率快速上升壓縮高本益比公司的估值，科技股就可能出現同步修正，而ETF因成分股集中於科技股，受修正影響的機會則被放大

這也是目前不少投資人面對的兩難：已經進場的人，漲多之後捨不得賣，卻又不敢在高檔繼續追；還沒有進場的人，看到市場快速輪動，又不知道下一個應該買什麼。當「所有ETF都在買AI」成為市場共識時，真正需要思考的反而不是還有哪些科技股可以追，而是投資組合是不是太過集中在同一個風險因子。當科技股估值偏高、盤勢震盪加劇，金融股的防禦價值就逐漸浮現。這不只發生在台股，也反映全球資產配置的變化。價值投資的重要精神之一，就是當市場熱門產業估值過高時，尋找具備實質獲利、穩定現金流與合理估值的產業。
因此，部分台股主動式ETF在市場震盪期間，開始增加大型金融股部位，背後邏輯並不難理解。銀行、保險、交易所及資產管理公司等金融企業，收入來源相較純科技成長股更加多元，除了利息收入，也包括手續費、交易佣金、資產管理與保險等現金流，在市場震盪時可以提供不同於科技股的投資因子。
就連波克夏的最新持倉，也透露出類似訊號。金融類股在其美股投資組合中仍占接近35%，高居主要產業配置之首。當全球股市處在高檔，投資組合的重點便不再只是追求最高成長，而是如何降低單一產業回檔所造成的資產傷害。

這也是00998A值得關注的原因。00998A為全台首檔全球金融主動式ETF，不強制追蹤單一指數，而是由經理人主動挑選全球具競爭力、高獲利與穩定配息能力的金融龍頭，投資範圍涵蓋歐美、日本大型銀行、保險公司、交易所，並搭配部分Fintech標的。若從分散風險的角度來看，全球金融類股與科技股歷史相關係數約0.58，並非完全同步，因此當AI科技股因估值修正而震盪時，金融股有機會發揮資產平滑效果。此外，並透過主動式操作，依照利率、景氣與金融市場環境調整持股。相較被動ETF必須依照指數權重持有成分股，主動式ETF可以在企業基本面轉弱時降低持股，投資彈性更高。收益方面，00998A採季配息與收益平準金機制，2026年6月首次每單位配息0.404元；最新9月每單位配息0.424元，以9月1日市價17.83元計算，年化配息率約9.52%。
因此，00998A真正吸引人的地方，不只是接近一成的現金流，而是提供了台股科技ETF之外的另一個產業配置選項。當AI仍是市場長期主軸，科技股當然不能缺席；但在高檔震盪環境下，真正成熟的資產配置，或許不是繼續把所有資金集中在同一個方向，而是在科技成長之外，增加金融股這類具備獲利、現金流與股息支撐的資產，讓投資組合從「只追求上漲」進一步走向「兼顧防禦」。
最近這段時間，大盤明顯量縮震盪，指數看起來沒跌多少，但真正做起來其實很難。
追高容易被洗、亂換股又很容易換錯，這種盤最考驗的不是膽量，而是你到底有沒有選對產業、選對股票。
以下是我近三期的

The strategy is to keep lowering positions in high‑P/E stocks, reduce exposure to over‑bought names, raise cash levels, wait for a market pull‑back, and then allocate to fundamentally solid AI and semiconductor core stocks. Meanwhile, higher oil prices could reignite inflation and alter expectations for future rate policy. These factors may all become catalysts for larger volatility in Taiwan stocks.

Looking at ETF performance over the past three months, the market has already shown clear divergence. From June 1 to August 31, the market‑cap‑weighted Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050) delivered a total return of only 1.32% including dividends. Among active ETFs, Uni‑Taiwan Growth (00981A) fell 5.36% while Uni‑Finance Dividend (00998A) rose 13.96% against the trend. High‑dividend ETFs saw Cathay Sustainable High Yield (00878) up 6.92% and Quanyi Taiwan Select High Yield (00919) up 10.12%. These figures show that as the market shifts from a broad rally to high‑level consolidation, capital begins to search for safe havens across different sectors and risk factors. For those already holding Taiwan equities, the biggest question is not “whether to keep investing” but whether the portfolio still has other assets that can provide support when tech stocks become more volatile.

In recent years the biggest structural change in Taiwan ETFs has been the rapid rise in AI and semiconductor weighting within the indices. In the 0050, AI‑related industries now account for over 70% of the basket, while financial stocks are only about 8%. In the active ETF 00981A, the constituents are almost entirely concentrated in AI and technology groups. Even the high‑dividend ETF, which appears diversified, has about 51% of its holdings in tech stocks (00878). This structure gives strong upside during AI’s high‑growth phase, but when tech valuations are already at lofty levels, investors’ risk becomes similarly concentrated. If AI capital spending is questioned, corporate earnings fall short, or U.S. Treasury yields rise sharply compressing valuations of high‑P/E companies, tech stocks could undergo a synchronized correction, and ETFs heavily weighted toward tech would feel an amplified impact.

This creates a dilemma for many investors: those already in the market are reluctant to sell after gains yet hesitant to chase higher prices; those not yet in are confused by the rapid rotation and unsure what to buy next. When the consensus becomes “all ETFs are buying AI,” the real issue is not which tech stocks to chase but whether the portfolio is overly concentrated in a single risk factor. As tech valuations stay high and market swings intensify, the defensive value of financial stocks begins to emerge. This pattern is not limited to Taiwan; it mirrors global asset‑allocation shifts. One core principle of value investing is to seek industries with real earnings, stable cash flow and reasonable valuations when hot sectors become over‑priced.

Consequently, some Taiwan active ETFs have started to increase positions in large‑cap financial stocks during market turbulence, a logic that is easy to understand. Banks, insurers, exchanges and asset‑management firms have more diversified revenue streams than pure‑play tech growth stocks, earning not only interest but also fees, commissions, asset‑management and insurance cash flows, which can provide a different investment factor when markets wobble.

Even Berkshire Hathaway’s latest holdings send a similar signal. Financial stocks still make up close to 35% of its U.S. equity portfolio, the largest sector allocation. When global equities sit at high levels, the portfolio focus shifts from chasing the highest growth to reducing the damage that a single‑industry pull‑back can cause.

From a diversification standpoint, the historical correlation between global financial stocks and tech stocks is about 0.58, not a perfect sync, so when AI‑related tech stocks wobble due to valuation adjustments, financials can provide a smoothing effect. Moreover, the active manager can adjust holdings based on interest rates, economic cycles and market conditions, unlike passive ETFs that must follow index weights. 00998A pays quarterly dividends and uses a smoothing mechanism; it distributed its first dividend of NT$0.404 per unit in June 2026, and the latest September payout was NT$0.424 per unit. items.title: 彩晶總經理陳盛中辭職 董事長焦佑麒暫代
items.title_en: Cai Jing General Manager Chen Shengzhong Resigns, Chairman Jiao Youqi Serves as Interim
paras: 面板廠彩晶(6116-TW)今(11)日公告，總經理陳盛中辭職，由董事長焦佑麒暫代；陳盛中也身兼彩晶資訊安全長，職缺則由副總經理邱博興接任。
彩晶近年積極朝高毛利、高附加價值產品轉型，加速布局車載、工控及無人機等利基型應用市場，目標明年車載產品營收比重提升至3成以上。除車載外，彩晶也積極布局工業控制、穿戴裝置與無人機應用。
此外，為提升資產使用效率及強化財務結構，彩晶4月底董事會也決議處分南科廠不動產，交易金額 43.2 億元，處分利益 21.6 億元，預計於第三季認列，處分資金將用於充實營運資金及增強未來發展動能。
彩晶8月營收9.34億元，月增7.1%、年增8%；累計前8月營收78.9億元，年增2.9%，為近3年同期最佳。
paras_en: Panel manufacturer Cai Jing (6116-TW) announced today (the 11th) that General Manager Chen Shengzhong has resigned, with Chairman Jiao Youqi temporarily assuming the role; Chen also served as the company's Chief Information Security Officer, and the vacancy will be filled by Vice President Qiu Boxing.

In recent years, Cai Jing has been actively shifting toward high‑margin, high‑value‑added products, accelerating its entry into niche markets such as automotive, industrial control and unmanned aerial vehicles, with a goal of raising the share of automotive product revenue to over 30% next year. In addition to automotive, the company is also pursuing opportunities in industrial control, wearable devices and UAV applications.

Furthermore, to improve asset utilization and strengthen its financial structure, the board approved at the end of April the disposal of real estate at its Southern Taiwan Science Park plant for a transaction amount of NT$4.32 billion, generating a disposal profit of NT$2.16 billion. The gain is expected to be recognized in the third quarter, and the proceeds will be used to bolster working capital and enhance future growth momentum.

Cai Jing reported August revenue of NT$934 million, up 7.1% month‑over‑month and 8% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$7.89 billion, a 2.9% annual increase and the best performance in the same period over the past three years.

items.title: AI浪潮與旺季效應共振 聯強看好四大業務齊揚 下半年營運拚逐季走高
items.title_en: AI Wave and Seasonal Surge Resonance: Lianqiang Optimistic About Four Major Businesses Rising Together, Aiming for Quarterly Growth in H2
paras: 通路商聯強(2347-TW)受惠企業AI投資、資料中心加速建置以及傳統資訊科技旺季來臨，公司看好四大業務皆維持成長走勢，其中半導體與商用加值持續扮演關鍵成長引擎，第3季與第4季營收具備逐季走高的成長機會。伴隨AI帶動市場規模與產品價值提升的結構性趨勢確立，公司預期這波強勁動能有望一路延續至2027年。

在業務核心引擎方面，聯強半導體業務受惠AI設備及資料中心擴建，成長主力集中於動態隨機存取記憶體與硬碟等儲存產品，不僅平均售價因價格上漲而推升，更搭上供需偏緊與新客戶增加利多，中央處理器與其他相關晶片產品也維持三成以上增幅。商用加值業務則受惠企業AI應用從試點邁向大規模部署，帶動伺服器、儲存、網路設備及資安等整合性需求，後續將持續結合MSP數智平台與AI應用平台，擴大企業級產品布局並深化產業鏈整合。
消費市場方面，資訊消費與通訊業務在下半年正式進入傳統拉貨旺季。隨著蘋果(AAPL-US)新機、輝達(NVDA-US)新一代顯示卡，以及AI PC與主機板等新品陸續上市，將強烈支撐終端換機與規格升級買氣。聯強評估上半年手機市場成長主要反映產品平均售價提高，並非提前透支下半年需求，因此持續對旺季拉貨表現維持樂觀看法。
從全球區域市場營運布局觀察，大陸市場後續可望受惠資訊科技設備國產化政策，以及政府與國營企業採購需求挹注。台灣市場則有IC設計、金融業與企業AI投資作為穩固支撐，紐澳市場逐步進入傳統消費旺季，印尼市場亦可望維持穩健成長態勢。
在整體營運策略上，面對大型專案增加可能對毛利率造成的產品組合影響，聯強明確表示不以單純拉高毛利率為唯一目標。公司將持續透過嚴格費用控管、MSP平台帶來的規模效益與營運效率提升，以擴大營業利益與整體獲利規模作為營運主軸。
作為下半年展望的堅實後盾，聯強日前公布8月合併營收達742億元，較去年同期大幅成長122%，改寫歷年同期新高並為歷史單月次高，累計前8月合併營收達4742億元，年增90%，已提前超越2025年全年營收水準。
paras_en: Lianqiang (ticker 2347‑TW), a distribution channel company, benefits from corporate AI investment, accelerated data‑center construction and the arrival of the traditional IT peak season. The company is confident that its four major businesses will continue to grow, with semiconductor and commercial value‑added segments remaining key growth engines. Revenue in Q3 and Q4 is expected to rise quarter‑over‑quarter. Driven by AI‑induced structural trends that expand market size and product value, the firm expects this strong momentum to continue through 2027.

Regarding its core business engines, Lianqiang’s semiconductor segment gains from AI equipment and data‑center expansion, with growth led by dynamic random‑access memory and storage products such as hard drives. Not only have average selling prices risen due to price hikes, but tighter supply‑demand balances and new customer acquisition also add upside. CPUs and other related chips have also posted gains of over 30%. The commercial value‑added business benefits from corporate AI applications moving from pilot to large‑scale deployment, driving integrated demand for servers, storage, networking gear and cybersecurity. Going forward, it will continue to combine its MSP digital platform with AI application platforms to broaden enterprise‑grade product offerings and deepen ecosystem integration.

In the consumer market, information‑technology and communications businesses enter the traditional pull‑season in the second half of the year. Apple (AAPL‑US) new devices, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) next‑generation graphics cards, as well as new AI PCs and motherboards are slated to launch, strongly supporting end‑user upgrade cycles and higher‑spec purchases. Lianqiang assesses that the first‑half mobile‑phone market growth mainly reflects higher average selling prices rather than an early depletion of second‑half demand, so it remains optimistic about the pull‑season performance.

From a global regional perspective, the mainland China market is expected to benefit from domestic‑production policies for IT equipment and procurement from government and state‑owned enterprises. Taiwan’s market is supported by IC design, financial services and corporate AI investment. The New Zealand‑Australia market is gradually entering its traditional consumer peak season, while Indonesia is also poised to maintain steady growth.

In its overall operating strategy, facing the possibility that large projects could affect gross‑margin through product‑mix changes, Lianqiang makes clear it does not pursue higher gross‑margin as the sole goal. The company will continue strict expense control, leverage scale economies and operational efficiencies from its MSP platform, and focus on expanding operating profit and overall profit scale as its core operating theme.

As a solid backing for the second‑half outlook, Lianqiang recently reported August consolidated revenue of NT$74.2 billion, up 122% year‑over‑year, setting a new high for the same period in history and ranking as the second‑highest monthly figure ever. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$474.2 billion, a 90% annual increase, already surpassing the full‑year 2025 revenue target ahead of schedule.

items.title: 高房貸利率抑制買氣 美國待售房屋供應量創10年新高
items.title_en: High Mortgage Rates Damp Buying Demand as US Home Supply Hits 10‑Year High
paras: 全美待售房屋庫存量在8月攀升至10年來新高，反映出高房貸利率以及通膨與地緣政治等經濟不確定性，正持續抑制買家的購屋意願。
根據美國全國房地產經紀人協會(NAR)數據，按目前銷售速度計算，8月份市場上的房屋供應量達4.9個月，創下逾十年新高。同時，成屋銷售量單月微幅下降2%。
根據房地美(Freddie Mac)資料，30年期固定房貸平均利率升至6.76%，為2025年夏季以來的最高水準。
NAR首席經濟學家Lawrence Yun表示，充足的待售房屋供應正為買家提供更好的議價空間。然而，在薪資增長支撐下，8月房屋中位售價仍年增1.6%，至429,100美元。由於高借貸成本嚇退潛在買家，加上許多既有屋主因鎖定早期的低利率而不願換房，使美國房市長期處於凍結狀態。
市場普遍預計房市活動將繼續放緩。凱投宏觀(Capital Economics)分析師預測，2026年將是十多年來房屋銷售最為疲軟的一年，且30年期房貸利率在未來兩年內恐維持在6%以上。
房地產機構Redfin與Zillow持類似觀點，Zillow更預期年底利率將達6.79%，全美房屋銷售前景依然充滿挑戰。
paras_en: US inventory of homes for sale rose in August to a ten‑year high, reflecting that high mortgage rates and economic uncertainty from inflation and geopolitics continue to suppress buyer enthusiasm.

According to data from the National Association of Realtors (NAR), the supply of homes on the market in August equated to 4.9 months of sales at the current pace, a level not seen in over a decade, while existing‑home sales slipped slightly by 2% month‑over‑month.
Freddie Mac data show the average rate on a 30‑year fixed‑rate mortgage climbed to 6.76%, the highest since the summer of 2025.

NAR chief economist Lawrence Yun said the ample supply of homes for sale is giving buyers better negotiating power. Yet, backed by wage growth, the median home price in August still rose 1.6% year‑over‑year to $429,100. High borrowing costs are scaring off potential buyers, and many existing owners are reluctant to move because they locked in lower rates earlier, leaving the market in a prolonged freeze.

The market is broadly expected to keep slowing. Capital Economics analyst predicts 2026 will be the weakest year for home sales in more than a decade, and 30‑year mortgage rates could stay above 6% for the next two years.
Real‑estate firms Redfin and Zillow share a similar outlook; Zillow even forecasts rates reaching 6.79% by year‑end, keeping the outlook for US home sales challenging.

items.title: 全球前十大IC設計Q2營收年增73% AMD擠進前三名

第三名超微得益於代理AI時代來臨，CPU重要性再度提升，第二季營收超過115.3億美元。其資料中心CPU營收已連續五季創下新高，不斷搶占英特爾(INTC-US) X86 伺服器市占率。
高通第二季儘管手機晶片業務仍處低迷，在新一代iPhone數據機晶片的占比也下滑，但車用市場已連續23個季度保持雙位數年增，抵消部分手機業務衝擊，營收逾85億美元，近期也重返資料中心業務，加速QCT部門的多角化布局。
聯發科營收同樣受手機業務影響，為48.1億美元左右，排名第五。但該公司上修AI ASIC業務展望，預計2026年資料中心營收將超過20億美元，2028年ASIC可服務市場規模上調至800億美元。
高速增長的互連需求推升邁威爾(MRVL-US)第二季營收至26.3億美元，排名第六。其PAM4 DSP晶片領先業界，800G DSP需求強勁、1.6T DSP正快速放量；客製化業務亦與Google達成合作協議，將於2029財年帶來顯著貢獻。

MPS主要成長引擎來自AI相關電源管理解決方案，本季營收9.81億美元，排名第八。該公司維持產能擴充，以支撐往半導體解決方案提供商轉型所需。
聯詠(3034-TW)本季營收9.07億美元，排名第九，營收成長主因是客戶提前拉貨的動能延續。其SoC晶片營收占比已超越5成，未來持續投入Edge AI等機器視覺SoC相關應用。
