items.title: 不只砍輝達空單！《大賣空》原型最新持倉曝光：多空雙殺  現金才是王道
items.title_en: Not Just Cutting Nvidia Shorts! The Real‑World Holdings Behind “The Big Short” Revealed: Double‑Sided Kill, Cash Is King
paras: 曾精準預測2008次貸危機的億萬富翁投資者、好萊塢電影《大賣空》原型Michael Burry近期調整投資組合，減少整體市場曝險，並平倉部分備受矚目的AI相關空頭部位。
根據最新披露的資訊，Burry已平倉輝達與Palantir在今年12月到期的看跌選擇權。Burry表示，此舉旨在持有更多現金，以便在秋季市場狀況變化時保留操作彈性。這項操作直接削減了他過去最受市場關注的AI領域空頭押注。
除調節空頭部位外，Burry也同步縮減多頭部位，目前他最大多頭持倉包括Lululemon、Molina Healthcare與MercadoLibre，但這些部位的規模均已遭下調。
在空頭佈局方面，Burry目前最大的空頭部位集中在甲骨文、Palantir與Nebius，輝達與iShares半導體ETF則位列其後。
此外，Burry還透露，他正密切關注美元現貨指數的疲軟走勢，暗示匯市波動可能成為他後續佈局的重要參考因素。
paras_en: Billionaire investor Michael Burry, who famously predicted the 2008 subprime crisis and was the real‑life inspiration for the Hollywood film “The Big Short,” has recently rebalanced his portfolio, reducing overall market exposure and closing out some highly watched AI‑related short positions.

According to newly disclosed information, Burry has closed his put options on Nvidia and Palantir that were set to expire in December this year. He said the move is intended to hold more cash so he can retain flexibility if market conditions shift in the fall, directly trimming his most publicized AI short bet.

In addition to trimming his shorts, Burry also scaled back his long positions. His biggest long holdings now include Lululemon, Molina Healthcare and MercadoLibre, but the size of each of these positions has been reduced.
On the short side, Burry’s largest current short positions are concentrated in Oracle, Palantir and Nebius, with Nvidia and the iShares Semiconductor ETF trailing behind.
Burry also disclosed that he is closely watching the weakening trend of the U.S. dollar spot index, suggesting that currency volatility may become an important factor in his future positioning.

items.title: 大摩看空Nike 目標價僅31美元、華爾街最低
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Bears Nike, Sets $31 Target – Wall Street Low
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，Nike(NKE-US)近期股價表現艱難，而摩根士丹利分析師認為，情況可能進一步惡化。
摩根士丹利周四(10日)重新開始追蹤Nike股票，並給予「減碼」(underweight)評級，同時設定31美元的目標價，為華爾街最低，遠低於Visible Alpha約48美元的市場共識。
Nike股價周四收盤下跌約2%，跌至12年來新低，低於37美元。
Visible Alpha追蹤的另外13位分析師中，僅有1位建議賣出Nike股票，另有10位給予「中立」評級，2位給予「買進」評級。
摩根士丹利表示，市場對Nike的共識預測「在太短時間內反映了過多成長預期，尤其是在中國市場」，並指出宏觀經濟逆風及競爭疑慮。分析師認為，Nike目前估值與「日益分化」的運動服飾市場現況並不相符。
這家服飾製造商距離執行長Elliott Hill於2024年底接任職務即將滿兩年。公司也在今年8月迎來新任財務長。
分析師表示，財務長人事異動，加上整體運動服飾市場面臨「壓力」，可能讓Nike即將於10月公布的財報，或11月舉行的年度投資人日，成為公司「重新設定市場預期」的良好時機，尤其是針對轉型速度的預期。
周四股價下跌後，Nike今年以來累計跌幅已超過40%。
paras_en: Investopedia reports that Nike (NKE-US) has been struggling recently, and Morgan Stanley analysts say the situation could worsen further.

Morgan Stanley resumed coverage of Nike on Thursday (the 10th), assigning an underweight rating and setting a $31 price target, the lowest on Wall Street and well below the roughly $48 market consensus tracked by Visible Alpha.
Nike’s stock closed down about 2% on Thursday, hitting a 12‑year low below $37.
Among the 13 other analysts tracked by Visible Alpha, only one recommends selling Nike, ten rate it neutral and two give it a buy rating.

Morgan Stanley says the market’s consensus forecast for Nike “reflects too much growth expectation in a short time, especially in China,” and points to macroeconomic headwinds and competitive concerns. The analysts argue Nike’s current valuation does not match the increasingly fragmented athletic apparel market.
The apparel maker is approaching the two‑year mark since CEO Elliott Hill took over at the end of 2024, and it welcomed a new CFO in August this year.

The analysts note that the CFO change, combined with pressure on the overall athletic apparel market, could make Nike’s earnings due in October or its annual investor day in November a good opportunity to reset market expectations, especially regarding the pace of its transformation.
After Thursday’s drop, Nike has fallen more than 40% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 川普拋出5000美元「分紅」計畫 共和黨內部反應平淡且分歧嚴重
items.title_en: Trump Proposes $5,000 “Dividend” Plan; Republican Reaction Tepid and Deeply Divided
paras: 美國總統川普提議，若共和黨在11月期中選舉獲勝，將向每位美國成年公民發放5000美元支票，此舉在掌控聯邦財政預算的國會共和黨內部引發了平淡且謹慎的反應。
這項計畫預計將耗費約1.35兆美元，在美國當前正面臨持續通膨以及國債突破40兆美元的背景下，讓黨內對於財政赤字與執行可行性充滿疑慮。
共和黨高層反應普遍保留。參議院多數黨領袖John Thune被問及參議院是否會批准該計畫時拒絕正面回答，僅表示「到時候再說」。眾議院稅務委員會主席Jason Smith雖表示原則上支持，但警告考量赤字問題，立法過關絕非易事。
相較之下，眾議院多數黨領袖Steve Scalise態度較為積極，表示國會將致力於精算數字並落實細節。
部分盟友與議員試圖挺身辯護或推動立法。副總統范斯(JD Vance)力挺該政策為「美國工人的紅利」，主張可由關稅收入籌措資金。參議員Bernie Moreno與Roger Marshall公開支持，Moreno更計畫提出相關法案推動國會表決。眾議員Jim Jordan表達支持讓民眾保留更多財富，但強調希望能先看到具體提案內容。
然而，黨內財政鷹派與保守派批評聲浪相當強烈。眾議員Chip Roy公開質疑政府無力負擔高額開支，並直言依賴政府是邪惡的。前眾議員Bob Good痛批這是「社會主義買票方案」，前川普立法事務主管Marc Short批評此提議偏離了財政責任與保守派經濟學。
此外，參議員Ted Cruz建議應結合工作要求並改為退稅形式，眾議員Ralph Norman則堅持每發放1美元必須有至少2美元的支出轉移抵銷。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump has proposed that if the Republican Party wins the November midterm elections, each adult American citizen would receive a $5,000 check. The proposal has elicited a muted and cautious response within the GOP ranks that control the federal budget in Congress.

The plan is expected to cost about $1.35 trillion, raising concerns among party members about fiscal deficits and feasibility amid ongoing inflation and a national debt that has now exceeded $40 trillion.

Republican leadership has generally responded with reservations. Senate Majority Leader John Thune declined to give a definitive answer when asked whether the Senate would approve the plan, saying only “we’ll see later.” House Ways and Means Committee Chairman Jason Smith said he supports the idea in principle but warned that deficit considerations make passage anything but easy.
In contrast, House Majority Leader Steve Scalise took a more upbeat stance, saying Congress will work to crunch the numbers and flesh out the details.

Some allies and lawmakers have stepped forward to defend or advance legislation. Vice‑presidential candidate JD Vance championed the policy as a “bonus for American workers,” arguing it could be funded with tariff revenues. Senators Bernie Moreno and Roger Marshall publicly backed the idea, with Moreno planning to introduce a bill to bring it to a vote. Representative Jim Jordan expressed support for letting people keep more of their wealth, but stressed he wants to see a concrete proposal first.

However, fiscal hawks and conservatives within the party have voiced strong criticism. Representative Chip Roy openly questioned the government’s ability to shoulder such high spending and called reliance on the government “evil.” Former Representative Bob Good slammed it as a “socialist vote‑buying scheme,” and former Trump legislative aide Marc Short said the proposal strays from fiscal responsibility and conservative economics.

Senator Ted Cruz suggested tying the payout to work requirements and delivering it as a tax rebate, while Representative Ralph Norman insisted that for every $1 given, at least $2 of spending must be offset elsewhere.

items.title: OpenAI傳考慮放慢AI開發！奧特曼倡議同業聯手 因應失控風險
items.title_en: OpenAI Says It Is Considering Slowing AI Development! Altman Calls for Industry Cooperation to Address Out‑of‑Control Risks
paras: 美媒引述知情人士說法報導，OpenAI正在考慮放慢尖端人工智慧(AI)的開發速度，並且希望其他AI公司一同響應，以回應不斷升高的AI風險。
根據彭博、路透等媒體，OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)本周在公司全體員工大會上透露，OpenAI可能放慢AI開發步調，甚至可能與其他幾家AI實驗室協調行動，但有一部分業者可能不願配合。
不少AI業界高層與員工一直以來都在警告，AI系統可能對人類生存構成風險，而這層疑慮在外界揭露OpenAI的AI代理人曾協同行動、突破限制並入侵第三方網站後進一步升高。由於後來還發生其他類似的安全事件，各界對新一代AI模型發動網攻的能力、以及各大AI公司阻止系統失控的能力，都打上問號。
過去幾周以來，陸續有頂尖AI公司的員工公開表示擔憂先進AI系統風險升高，讓這些企業公司內部焦慮升高，尤其是以秘密提交上市相關文件的OpenAI與Anthropic。
AI研究員Jacob Coxon本周二辭職，指控他的兩名前雇主Anthropic與OpenAI為了競逐超級智慧AI，不惜「拿我們的生命下注」。根據Coxon在社群媒體的發文，開發AI的人相信AI可能「在這十年內殺死所有人類」。
這番言論迅速引起注意，獲得超過1.5億次瀏覽，也引起知名議員與公眾人物關注。
兩名近期離開Anthropic與Google DeepMind職位的研究人員，周四也公開表達對AI快速開發步調的擔憂，表示AI開發商需要對這項技術的風險更加透明。
OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki近日也發文警告AI的危險，並表示他認為AI公司應該「視需要協調放慢未來的開發」。Pachocki指出，他希望「在建立共同的安全標準之前，自願放慢開發速度能成為普遍做法」。
OpenAI表示，最近已放慢部分模型的開發進度，並因安全疑慮暫停一部分的內部AI訓練。奧特曼7月則透露，他曾與白宮官員討論「放慢AI開發步調的必要性」。
paras_en: U.S. media, citing informed sources, report that OpenAI is considering slowing the pace of cutting‑edge artificial intelligence (AI) development and hopes other AI firms will join in response to the rising AI risks.

According to Bloomberg, Reuters and other outlets, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman disclosed at this week’s all‑hands meeting that the company may decelerate its AI development and might even coordinate actions with several other AI labs, though some players may be unwilling to cooperate.

Many senior AI executives and employees have long warned that AI systems could pose existential threats to humanity, and these concerns intensified after it was revealed that OpenAI’s AI agents had collaborated, breached limits and infiltrated third‑party websites. Subsequent similar security incidents have raised doubts about the new‑generation AI models’ capacity for cyber‑attacks and the ability of major AI firms to prevent system runaway.

In recent weeks, employees at top AI companies have publicly expressed growing anxiety over the heightened risk of advanced AI systems, fueling internal unease at firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic, which have quietly filed SEC‑related documents.

AI researcher Jacob Coxon resigned on Tuesday, accusing his former employers Anthropic and OpenAI of “betting our lives” in the race for super‑intelligent AI. In a social‑media post, Coxon said developers believe AI could “kill all humans within a decade.”
The remarks quickly attracted attention, garnering over 150 million views and drawing the notice of prominent lawmakers and public figures.

Two researchers who recently left positions at Anthropic and Google DeepMind also voiced concerns on Thursday about the rapid pace of AI development, urging developers to be more transparent about the technology’s risks.

OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki recently posted a warning about AI dangers, stating he believes AI firms should “coordinate to slow future development as needed.” Pachocki said he hopes “voluntary slowing of development before establishing common safety standards becomes the norm.”

OpenAI said it has already slowed development on some models and paused certain internal AI training due to safety concerns. Altman disclosed in July that he discussed the “need to slow AI development” with White House officials.

items.title: 今晚美國CPI成Fed升息關鍵！通膨若超預期 9月恐重啟升息
items.title_en: Tonight's US CPI Is Key to the Fed's Rate Hike Decision! If Inflation Exceeds Expectations, September May See a Rate Hike Restart
paras: 美國8月消費者價格指數(CPI)將於今日(11日)公布，這是聯準會(Fed)9月議息會議前最後一份通膨報告。在8月就業數據明顯強於預期、市場重新加碼押注升息之後，這份數據可能直接決定聯準會是否自2023年以來首次升息。
據路透統計的預測中值，8月CPI月增率預計上漲0.4%，高於7月的0.1%；年增率則預計維持在3.4%。扣除食品和能源後的核心CPI預計月增0.2%，年增率料將從2.5%降至2.4%。
法國Natixis銀行美國經濟學家Christopher Hodge稱，「這是相當長一段時間以來最重要的一次CPI數據。」在他看來，聯準會是否於下周採取行動，已經處於「刀刃邊緣」。
8月整體CPI月增率恐明顯加速，主要原因預計來自能源價格反彈，而核心價格壓力變化相對有限。
7月美國CPI月增率僅上漲0.1%。Kiplinger經濟學家David Payne指出，當月汽油價格下降2.9%，藥品價格下降0.8%，食品價格漲幅也較溫和，共同壓低了整體通膨。
進入8月，能源價格重新走高。伊朗戰爭再度出現衝突，波斯灣和紅海原油運輸繼續受到影響。WTI原油期貨一度因和平談判進展回落，但隨著談判停滯、衝突恢復，最終以每桶85.76美元結束8月，較月初上漲約1%。
富國銀行預計，8月美國汽油價格月增率上漲略高於4%，食品價格也可能重新上漲，推動整體CPI月增率升至0.40%。但該行預計核心CPI僅上漲0.23%，基本維持7月增速。
核心通膨的總體趨勢仍在回落。今年初，美國核心通膨為2.5%，3月以後受油價和關稅影響一度上升，5月接近3%。此後隨著關稅影響減弱、油價回落和住房成本降溫，核心通膨重新降至2.5%，8月預計進一步回落至2.4%。
住房成本是關鍵變數。高盛預計，業主等價租金和主要住宅租金的月增率，將從7月均為0.26%，分別降至8月的0.22%和0.23%。兩項合計佔核心CPI權重超過40%。
Hodge認為，除AI和資料中心建設相關領域外，目前很難找到能夠推動核心通膨重新明顯加速的來源。
AI投資與油價成為新的通膨風險
AI資料中心建設正在成為傳統能源和住房之外的新價格壓力。AI資料中心建設正在對記憶體和資料儲存價格形成上行壓力，相關價格壓力也可能開始反映到CPI中。
7月PC價格上漲，對核心商品價格0.2%的月增幅貢獻約四分之一。先鋒領航預計，8月核心商品價格月增0.15%，並認為AI相關通膨正從電腦軟體和配件向更多商品擴散。
能源上漲還可能透過航空燃油進入核心服務價格。7月美國機票價格上漲超過2%，Vanguard預計8月漲幅大致相當，高盛則預計機票價格可能進一步上漲4%。
與此同時，國際油價再次成為聯準會決策中的重要變數。Siebert Financial投資長Mark Malek指出，布蘭特原油已經再度來到每桶100美元附近，而聯準會主席沃什上月在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會上明確表示，今年夏季好於預期的通膨數據「並不能告訴我潛在趨勢已經出現實質性改善」。
這使聯準會面臨一個更複雜的組合：核心通膨和住房成本仍在降溫，但能源價格重新上漲，AI投資又開始推高部分商品價格。如果這些壓力向更廣泛的服務和商品擴散，通膨下降趨勢可能再次受阻。
截至9月10日，據CME「聯準會觀察」，聯準會到9月維持利率不變的概率為39.8%，累計升息25個基點的概率為60.2%。聯準會自去年12月以來一直將聯邦基金利率維持在3.50%至3.75%。
美國銀行的美國經濟學家Stephen Juneau認為，華許在傑克森霍爾的講話明顯偏鷹，並降低了重新升息的門檻。8月CPI及其對核心個人消費支出價格指數(PCE)的影響，可能直接決定9月是否升息。
Juneau預計，本周通膨數據將「足夠堅挺」，推動聯準會升息。Vanguard美國經濟學家Josh Hirt則預計，聯準會將繼續按兵不動。他估計，本周CPI和PPI對應的8月核心PCE月增率約為0.24%，仍處於聯準會可以接受的範圍，但幾乎沒有容錯空間。
Juneau提出了更激進的風險情境。如果8月通膨明顯惡化，聯準會不僅可能在9月升息25個基點，10月和12月也可能繼續升息。
因此，市場關注的重點不僅是整體CPI是否因能源價格反彈而走高，還包括這種壓力是否開始向核心商品和服務擴散。多位經濟學家認為，如果核心通膨繼續保持溫和，聯準會仍有維持利率不變的空間。如果CPI明顯偏熱，9月升息的可能性將隨之上升。
Hodge認為，在美國通膨已經連續65個月高於2%目標的情況下，聯準會對一次性價格衝擊的耐心正在下降。「我認為現在核心和整體數據的重要性，已經高於具體分項，這和我過去的看法不同。」
paras_en: The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) for August will be released today (the 11th), marking the last inflation report before the Fed's September policy meeting. After August employment data came in well above expectations and markets renewed bets on a rate hike, this data could directly determine whether the Fed will raise rates for the first time since 2023.

According to Reuters' median forecast, August CPI is expected to rise 0.4% month‑over‑month, up from July's 0.1%; the year‑over‑year increase is projected to stay at 3.4%. Core CPI, which excludes food and energy, is forecast to rise 0.2% month‑over‑month, with the annual rate slipping from 2.5% to 2.4%.
Christopher Hodge, a US economist at France's Natixis, said, "This is the most important CPI data in a long time." In his view, whether the Fed will act next week is already "on a knife‑edge."
The overall CPI month‑over‑month rate for August is feared to accelerate sharply, mainly due to a rebound in energy prices, while core price pressures are expected to change only modestly.

July's US CPI rose just 0.1% month‑over‑month. Kiplinger economist David Payne noted that gasoline fell 2.9%, drug prices dropped 0.8%, and food price gains were modest, together pulling overall inflation lower.

In August, energy prices rose again. Renewed conflict in the Iran war disrupted oil shipments in the Persian Gulf and Red Sea. WTI crude futures briefly fell on progress in peace talks but rebounded as talks stalled and fighting resumed, ending August at $85.76 per barrel, about 1% higher than at the start of the month.

Wells Fargo expects August US gasoline prices to rise a little over 4% month‑over‑month, and food prices may climb again, pushing the overall CPI month‑over‑month rate to 0.40%. The bank, however, projects core CPI to increase only 0.23%, essentially matching July's pace.

The overall trend in core inflation remains downward. At the start of the year, US core inflation was 2.5%; it rose after March due to oil prices and tariffs, nearing 3% in May. Since then, as tariff effects faded, oil prices fell and housing costs cooled, core inflation fell back to 2.5% and is expected to dip further to 2.4% in August.

Housing costs are a key variable. Goldman Sachs expects the owners' equivalent rent and primary residence rent month‑over‑month rates, both 0.26% in July, to fall to 0.22% and 0.23% respectively in August. Together they account for more than 40% of core CPI weight.
Hodge believes that aside from AI and data‑center construction, it is currently hard to find any source that could noticeably accelerate core inflation again.
AI investment and oil prices become new inflation risks

AI data‑center construction is emerging as a new price pressure beyond traditional energy and housing. It is putting upward pressure on memory and storage prices, and these pressures could start to show up in the CPI.

July PC prices rose, contributing about a quarter of the 0.2% month‑over‑month increase in core goods prices. Pioneer Leading expects August core goods prices to rise 0.15% month‑over‑month and says AI‑related inflation is spreading from software and accessories to more products.

Higher energy costs may also feed into core service prices via jet fuel. US airline ticket prices rose more than 2% in July; Vanguard expects a similar rise in August, while Goldman Sachs forecasts ticket prices could climb another 4%.

At the same time, international oil prices are once again a crucial factor in Fed decision‑making. Mark Malek, CIO of Siebert Financial, noted that Brent crude has returned to around $100 per barrel, and Fed Chair Powell last month at the Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium made clear that better‑than‑expected summer inflation data "does not tell me the underlying trend has materially improved."

This gives the Fed a more complex mix: core inflation and housing costs are still cooling, but energy prices are rising again and AI investment is pushing up some commodity prices. If these pressures spread to a broader range of services and goods, the downward trend in inflation could be stalled again.

As of September 10, CME's FedWatch indicates a 39.8% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September and a 60.2% chance of a 25‑basis‑point hike. The Fed has kept the federal funds rate in the 3.50%‑3.75% range since December last year.

US Bank economist Stephen Juneau says Powell's Jackson Hole remarks were clearly hawkish and lowered the threshold for another rate hike. August CPI and its impact on the core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) index could directly decide whether there will be a hike in September.

Juneau expects this week’s inflation data to be "sufficiently robust" to push the Fed to raise rates. Vanguard US economist Josh Hirt, however, predicts the Fed will stay on hold. He estimates that the August core PCE month‑over‑month rate, derived from this week’s CPI and PPI, will be about 0.24%, still within the Fed’s acceptable range but leaving almost no margin for error.

Juneau outlines a more aggressive risk scenario: if August inflation deteriorates sharply, the Fed could not only raise rates by 25 basis points in September but also continue hikes in October and December.

Thus, the market’s focus is not only on whether overall CPI climbs due to rebounding energy prices, but also on whether that pressure is spilling into core goods and services. Several economists say that if core inflation stays moderate, the Fed still has room to keep rates steady. If CPI runs noticeably hot, the odds of a September hike rise.

Hodge believes that with US inflation having stayed above the 2% target for 65 consecutive months, the Fed’s patience for one‑off price shocks is waning. "I think the importance of core and overall data now outweighs that of specific components, which is a shift from my previous view," he said.

items.title: 美股連漲3年養出「錯誤安全感」？專家建議重新平衡股債配置
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks' Three-Year Rally Breeds a "False Sense of Security"? Experts Advise Rebalancing Stock‑Bond Allocation
paras: 《CNBC》報導，全球債市遭到拋售、美股仍徘徊歷史高檔，加上地緣政治與通膨前景充滿不確定性，理財顧問認為，投資人可趁此時重新檢視資產配置，將投資組合調整回符合自身風險承受度的比例。
近年美股漲勢強勁，S&P 500指數在2023年至2025年分別上漲24%、23%及16%，連續3年繳出雙位數報酬，2026年迄今漲幅仍超過11%。隨著股票價值攀升，許多投資組合中的股票比重可能已高於原先設定，承擔的風險也隨之增加。
加州奧克蘭認證理財規劃師Cathy Curtis表示，不只重押科技股的投資人面臨這種情況，由於近年漲勢擴及多個產業，股票在多數投資組合中的占比都已提高。
與此同時，伊朗戰爭2月底爆發後，全球債市持續走弱。
投資人對通膨與政府債務的憂慮升高，推動多國公債殖利率升至多年高點。
由於債券價格與殖利率呈反向變動，美國10年期公債殖利率週三升至2023年以來最高，追蹤中長期美債價格的基金也同步下跌。
截至週三下午，iShares 7至10年期美國公債ETF (IEF-US) 今年以來下跌超過4%，Fidelity長期美國公債指數基金 (FNBGX-US)則跌逾5%。股債走勢分化，使部分投資人的資產配置進一步偏向股票。
所謂「再平衡」，是將投資組合恢復至原先設定的資產比例。以傳統60/40投資組合為例，若股票上漲使其比重超過60%，投資人可出售部分股票，並將資金轉入債券，使配置重新回到60%股票、40%債券。
紐奧良認證理財規劃師Jude Boudreaux指出，再平衡雖然不是最受關注的投資策略，卻相當實用。這種作法可將部分獲利從表現較好的資產轉往價格較低的資產，以有紀律的方式落實低買高賣。
在目前環境下，再平衡通常意味著降低股票比重、增加債券配置。雖然債券基金近期價格下跌，可能讓部分投資人卻步，但理財顧問認為，這也提供以較低價格增加債券部位的機會。
再平衡還能減少情緒對投資決策的干擾，避免投資人試圖預測市場時點。
近期油價突破每桶100美元，加劇通膨疑慮，美股週三隨之走低；伊朗戰爭、Fed新任主席、選舉週期、財政赤字及AI衝擊，也使市場不確定性升高。
Curtis表示，與其猜測哪些因素最終會主導市場，不如透過再平衡，將風險降回較合理的水準。
亞特蘭大認證理財規劃師Kamila Elliott也提醒，連續多年的強勁報酬可能使投資人產生錯誤的安全感，忘記市場仍可能下跌。
不過，再平衡並不代表全面賣出股票、將資金轉為現金，而是依據自身承受損失的能力，確認股票、債券與現金配置是否仍符合原定目標。
對接近退休的投資人而言，目前也可考慮將部分股票獲利轉入現金部位，以便退休初期若股市下跌，仍有資金可支應生活開銷。
理財顧問同時提醒投資人也不必一次完成所有調整，可透過新增資金、提款或兼顧稅務的交易，逐步將投資組合拉回目標比例。
paras_en: CNBC reports that global bond markets have been sold off while U.S. equities remain near historic highs, and with geopolitical tensions and inflation outlooks still uncertain, financial advisers say investors can use this moment to review asset allocation and shift portfolios back to a risk level that matches their tolerance.

U.S. equities have surged in recent years, with the S&P 500 up 24%, 23% and 16% in 2023, 2024 and 2025 respectively, delivering double‑digit returns for three straight years, and the year‑to‑date gain in 2026 is already over 11%. As stock values rise, the equity weight in many portfolios may now exceed the original target, increasing the risk taken.

Certified financial planner Cathy Curtis of Oakland, California, says it’s not only tech‑heavy investors facing this issue; because the rally has spread across multiple sectors, the stock share in most portfolios has risen.
At the same time, after the Iran war broke out at the end of February, global bond markets have continued to weaken.
Investors’ worries about inflation and government debt have pushed sovereign‑bond yields in many countries up to multi‑year highs.

Because bond prices move inversely to yields, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose on Wednesday to its highest level since 2023, and funds that track medium‑ to long‑term U.S. Treasury prices fell in tandem.

As of Wednesday afternoon, the iShares 7‑10 Year Treasury ETF (IEF‑US) is down more than 4% year‑to‑date, and the Fidelity Long‑Term Treasury Index Fund (FNBGX‑US) has slipped over 5%. The divergence between stocks and bonds has nudged some investors’ allocations further toward equities.

Rebalancing means restoring a portfolio to its original asset mix. For a traditional 60/40 portfolio, if equities rise above 60% of the mix, an investor can sell some stocks and move the proceeds into bonds to bring the allocation back to 60% stocks and 40% bonds.

New Orleans‑based certified planner Jude Boudreaux notes that while rebalancing isn’t the most talked‑about strategy, it is very practical. It lets investors shift part of the gains from better‑performing assets into lower‑priced ones, implementing a disciplined buy‑low, sell‑high approach.

In the current environment, rebalancing usually means cutting equity weight and adding bonds. Although bond funds have recently fallen in price, which may deter some investors, advisers say this also creates an opportunity to increase bond positions at lower cost.
Rebalancing also reduces the influence of emotions on investment decisions, helping investors avoid trying to time the market.

Oil prices recently broke $100 a barrel, heightening inflation concerns and pulling U.S. stocks lower on Wednesday; the Iran war, the Fed’s new chair, election cycles, fiscal deficits and AI disruptions have also raised market uncertainty.
Curtis says that instead of guessing which factor will ultimately drive the market, investors are better off rebalancing to bring risk back to a more reasonable level.
Atlanta‑based certified planner Kamila Elliott warns that years of strong returns can give investors a false sense of safety, causing them to forget that markets can still fall.

However, rebalancing does not mean selling all stocks and moving everything to cash; it means assessing whether the stock, bond and cash mix still aligns with the original target based on one’s loss‑tolerance capacity.
For investors nearing retirement, it may be prudent now to shift some equity gains into cash so that, if the market drops early in retirement, there will still be funds available for living expenses.

Advisers also remind investors that they don’t have to make all adjustments at once; they can gradually bring the portfolio back to target ratios through new contributions, withdrawals or tax‑efficient trades.

items.title: 高房貸利率抑制買氣 美國待售房屋供應量創10年新高
items.title_en: High Mortgage Rates Damp Buying Demand as US Home Supply Hits 10‑Year High
paras: 全美待售房屋庫存量在8月攀升至10年來新高，反映出高房貸利率以及通膨與地緣政治等經濟不確定性，正持續抑制買家的購屋意願。
根據美國全國房地產經紀人協會(NAR)數據，按目前銷售速度計算，8月份市場上的房屋供應量達4.9個月，創下逾十年新高。同時，成屋銷售量單月微幅下降2%。
根據房地美(Freddie Mac)資料，30年期固定房貸平均利率升至6.76%，為2025年夏季以來的最高水準。
NAR首席經濟學家Lawrence Yun表示，充足的待售房屋供應正為買家提供更好的議價空間。然而，在薪資增長支撐下，8月房屋中位售價仍年增1.6%，至429,100美元。由於高借貸成本嚇退潛在買家，加上許多既有屋主因鎖定早期的低利率而不願換房，使美國房市長期處於凍結狀態。
市場普遍預計房市活動將繼續放緩。凱投宏觀(Capital Economics)分析師預測，2026年將是十多年來房屋銷售最為疲軟的一年，且30年期房貸利率在未來兩年內恐維持在6%以上。
房地產機構Redfin與Zillow持類似觀點，Zillow更預期年底利率將達6.79%，全美房屋銷售前景依然充滿挑戰。
paras_en: US inventory of homes for sale rose in August to a ten‑year high, reflecting that high mortgage rates and economic uncertainty from inflation and geopolitics continue to suppress buyer enthusiasm.

According to data from the National Association of Realtors (NAR), the supply of homes on the market in August equated to 4.9 months of sales at the current pace, a level not seen in over a decade, while existing‑home sales slipped slightly by 2% month‑over‑month.
Freddie Mac data show the average rate on a 30‑year fixed‑rate mortgage climbed to 6.76%, the highest since the summer of 2025.

NAR chief economist Lawrence Yun said the ample supply of homes for sale is giving buyers better negotiating power. Yet, backed by wage growth, the median home price in August still rose 1.6% year‑over‑year to $429,100. High borrowing costs are scaring off potential buyers, and many existing owners are reluctant to move because they locked in lower rates earlier, leaving the market in a prolonged freeze.

The market is broadly expected to keep slowing. Capital Economics analyst predicts 2026 will be the weakest year for home sales in more than a decade, and 30‑year mortgage rates could stay above 6% for the next two years.
Real‑estate firms Redfin and Zillow share a similar outlook; Zillow even forecasts rates reaching 6.79% by year‑end, keeping the outlook for US home sales challenging.

items.title: 全球前十大IC設計Q2營收年增73% AMD擠進前三名
items.title_en: Global Top Ten IC Designers See 73% YoY Revenue Growth in Q2, AMD Breaks Into Top Three
paras: 研調機構TrendForce今(11)日釋出最新IC設計產業研究，隨著AI相關應用擴張，GPU、CPU、ASIC、互連產品等需求攀升，帶動第二季全球前十大IC設計業者營收年增73%，突破1,414.5億美元。輝達(NVDA-US)穩居榜首、博通(AVGO-US)排名第二，超微(AMD-US)受惠CPU於代理AI應用提升，排名升至第三。高通(QCOM-US)則因手機業務走弱，退居第四名。
輝達第二季營收年增99%，近911.6億美元，於前十大業者營收占比成長至64%。除了超大型雲端服務供應商為其主要客戶，Neo Cloud客戶、主權AI、企業客戶也對營收有顯著貢獻。
TrendForce表示，輝達近期藉由擴大NVLink Fusion生態系，參與ASIC相關市場。如投資聯發科(2454-TW)以協助客製化XPU客戶加強與現有NVIDIA基礎建設互通，並為將來的車用AI領域作布局。在此之前投資邁威爾也將NVLink Fusion納入合作項目。
博通第二季營收排名第二，其協助設計的OpenAI首款ASIC、Google TPU 8i於本季開始出貨，網通業務也隨XPU同步高速成長，營收年增幅高達112%，逾188.9億美元，包含Anthropic、OpenAI等前瞻模型(frontier model)開發商在內的六大客製化晶片客戶將持續驅動其XPU需求。
第三名超微得益於代理AI時代來臨，CPU重要性再度提升，第二季營收超過115.3億美元。其資料中心CPU營收已連續五季創下新高，不斷搶占英特爾(INTC-US) X86 伺服器市占率。
高通第二季儘管手機晶片業務仍處低迷，在新一代iPhone數據機晶片的占比也下滑，但車用市場已連續23個季度保持雙位數年增，抵消部分手機業務衝擊，營收逾85億美元，近期也重返資料中心業務，加速QCT部門的多角化布局。
聯發科營收同樣受手機業務影響，為48.1億美元左右，排名第五。但該公司上修AI ASIC業務展望，預計2026年資料中心營收將超過20億美元，2028年ASIC可服務市場規模上調至800億美元。
高速增長的互連需求推升邁威爾(MRVL-US)第二季營收至26.3億美元，排名第六。其PAM4 DSP晶片領先業界，800G DSP需求強勁、1.6T DSP正快速放量；客製化業務亦與Google達成合作協議，將於2029財年帶來顯著貢獻。
瑞昱(2379-TW)第二季營收近11.9億美元，排名第七。由於預期2026下半年PC表現將更加低迷，其規劃以現有強勢IP切入server市場，如10G乙太網、server control plane交換機等。
MPS主要成長引擎來自AI相關電源管理解決方案，本季營收9.81億美元，排名第八。該公司維持產能擴充，以支撐往半導體解決方案提供商轉型所需。
聯詠(3034-TW)本季營收9.07億美元，排名第九，營收成長主因是客戶提前拉貨的動能延續。其SoC晶片營收占比已超越5成，未來持續投入Edge AI等機器視覺SoC相關應用。
OmniVision本季半導體設計營收為8.38億美元，排名第十。雖然記憶體價格影響手機、車用CIS業務，但運動相機等新興應用強勁成長，類比IC則已布局光通訊EIC，包含TIA、Driver等晶片。
paras_en: Research firm TrendForce released its latest IC design industry study today, noting that expanding AI‑related applications have boosted demand for GPUs, CPUs, ASICs and interconnect products, driving a 73% year‑over‑year increase in Q2 revenue for the world’s top ten IC designers to a record $141.45 billion. NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) remains at the top, Broadcom (AVGO‑US) is second, and AMD (AMD‑US) climbs to third thanks to higher CPU sales for AI workloads. Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) falls to fourth as its handset business weakens.

NVIDIA’s Q2 revenue jumped 99% to about $91.16 billion, raising its share of the top‑ten designers’ total revenue to 64%. In addition to hyperscale cloud providers, its Neo Cloud, sovereign AI and enterprise customers also contributed significantly.

TrendForce said NVIDIA has recently expanded its NVLink Fusion ecosystem to enter the ASIC market, investing in MediaTek (2454‑TW) to help custom XPU customers integrate with existing NVIDIA infrastructure and to lay groundwork for automotive AI. Earlier, it invested in Marvell, also incorporating NVLink Fusion into joint projects.

Broadcom posted the second‑largest Q2 revenue, helped by the OpenAI‑designed ASIC and Google’s TPU 8i, which began shipping this quarter. Its networking business grew rapidly alongside XPU demand, delivering a 112% YoY increase to over $18.89 billion, with six custom‑chip customers such as Anthropic and OpenAI driving further XPU sales.

AMD, now third, benefited from the AI‑driven resurgence of CPUs, posting Q2 revenue of more than $11.53 billion. Its data‑center CPU sales have hit new highs for five consecutive quarters, steadily eroding Intel’s (INTC‑US) X86 server market share.

Despite a slump in its handset chip segment and a lower share of the next‑generation iPhone modem market, Qualcomm’s Q2 revenue topped $8.5 billion, helped by a 23‑quarter streak of double‑digit growth in automotive chips that offset some handset weakness. The company also returned to the data‑center arena, accelerating diversification in its QCT unit.

MediaTek’s Q2 revenue, also hit by the handset slowdown, was around $4.81 billion, placing it fifth. The firm raised its AI‑ASIC outlook, projecting data‑center revenue to exceed $2 billion by 2026 and expanding its 2028 ASIC addressable market to $80 billion.

Rapid growth in interconnect demand lifted Marvell’s (MRVL‑US) Q2 revenue to $2.63 billion, ranking sixth. Its PAM4 DSP chips lead the market, with strong 800 Gbps DSP demand and fast‑growing 1.6 Tbps DSP volumes; a custom‑chip partnership with Google is set to deliver significant contributions in fiscal 2029.

Realtek (2379‑TW) posted Q2 revenue of about $1.19 billion, ranking seventh. Anticipating a weaker second half of 2026 for PCs, the company plans to leverage its strong IP portfolio to enter the server market with products such as 10‑Gb Ethernet and server control‑plane switches.

MPS’s main growth driver is AI‑related power‑management solutions, delivering Q2 revenue of $981 million and ranking eighth. The company continues capacity expansion to support its transition toward a semiconductor‑solutions provider.

Novatek (3034‑TW) recorded Q2 revenue of $907 million, ranking ninth, with growth driven by customers pulling forward orders. Its SoC revenue now exceeds 50% of total sales, and it will keep investing in Edge AI and machine‑vision SoC applications.

OmniVision’s semiconductor‑design revenue for the quarter was $838 million, ranking tenth. While memory‑price pressure hurts its mobile and automotive CIS businesses, strong growth in action‑camera and other emerging applications offsets the impact, and its analog IC line is expanding into optical‑communication EICs such as TIAs and drivers.

items.title: 不只砍輝達空單！《大賣空》原型最新持倉曝光：多空雙殺  現金才是王道
items.title_en: Not Just Cutting Nvidia Shorts! The Real‑World Holdings Behind “The Big Short” Revealed: Double‑Sided Kill, Cash Is King
paras: 曾精準預測2008次貸危機的億萬富翁投資者、好萊塢電影《大賣空》原型Michael Burry近期調整投資組合，減少整體市場曝險，並平倉部分備受矚目的AI相關空頭部位。
根據最新披露的資訊，Burry已平倉輝達與Palantir在今年12月到期的看跌選擇權。Burry表示，此舉旨在持有更多現金，以便在秋季市場狀況變化時保留操作彈性。這項操作直接削減了他過去最受市場關注的AI領域空頭押注。
除調節空頭部位外，Burry也同步縮減多頭部位，目前他最大多頭持倉包括Lululemon、Molina Healthcare與MercadoLibre，但這些部位的規模均已遭下調。
在空頭佈局方面，Burry目前最大的空頭部位集中在甲骨文、Palantir與Nebius，輝達與iShares半導體ETF則位列其後。
此外，Burry還透露，他正密切關注美元現貨指數的疲軟走勢，暗示匯市波動可能成為他後續佈局的重要參考因素。
paras_en: Billionaire investor Michael Burry, who famously predicted the 2008 subprime crisis and was the real‑life inspiration for the Hollywood film “The Big Short,” has recently rebalanced his portfolio, reducing overall market exposure and closing out some highly watched AI‑related short positions.

According to newly disclosed information, Burry has closed his put options on Nvidia and Palantir that were set to expire in December this year. He said the move is intended to hold more cash so he can retain flexibility if market conditions shift in the fall, directly trimming his most publicized AI short bet.

In addition to trimming his shorts, Burry also scaled back his long positions. His biggest long holdings now include Lululemon, Molina Healthcare and MercadoLibre, but the size of each of these positions has been reduced.
On the short side, Burry’s largest current short positions are concentrated in Oracle, Palantir and Nebius, with Nvidia and the iShares Semiconductor ETF trailing behind.
Burry also disclosed that he is closely watching the weakening trend of the U.S. dollar spot index, suggesting that currency volatility may become an important factor in his future positioning.

items.title: 重開荷姆茲海峽有譜？波灣國家傳下周一會晤伊朗 討論航運協議
items.title_en: Is Reopening the Hormuz Strait Feasible? Gulf Nations Say They’ll Meet Iran Next Monday to Discuss Shipping Agreement
paras: 英國《金融時報》(Financial Times)引述知情人士說法報導，波斯灣國家外交部長計劃未來一周與伊朗外長會面，以討論阿曼和伊朗之間推動、旨在讓商船通過荷姆茲海峽的臨時協議。
根據報導，這場會議預定下周一(14日)在阿曼沿海城市塞拉萊(Salalah)舉行，已有數個國家同意參加這場會議。
伊朗多次表示，在美國停止封鎖及攻擊伊朗港口前，荷姆茲海峽將保持關閉狀態。伊朗軍方也警告，任何未經授權試圖通過這條水道的船隻，都將遭到攻擊或被列入制裁名單。
這條運輸石油的重要航運要道正受到嚴重干擾，在此同時，葉門胡塞組織(Houthis)與沙烏地阿拉伯之間逐漸升溫的衝突，也威脅另一條重要航運通道曼德海峽(Bab el-Mandeb Strait)的供應。
伊朗與阿曼8月曾釋出接近達成重開荷姆茲海峽航運的協議，但在華府持續對伊朗實施海上封鎖的情況下，任何協議可能都需要取得美國批准。
美國和伊朗本周爆發了幾場2月開戰迄今最嚴重的航運攻擊，國際油價應聲大漲，顯示雙方衝突幾乎沒有降溫跡象。美國基本上也反對任何由伊朗與阿曼達成、但未納入美國的協議，並警告其他波斯灣國家不要與伊朗談判。
paras_en: The British Financial Times, citing informed sources, reported that foreign ministers of Gulf states plan to meet with Iran’s foreign minister within the next week to discuss a provisional agreement between Oman and Iran aimed at allowing merchant vessels to pass through the Hormuz Strait.
According to the report, the meeting is scheduled for next Monday (the 14th) in the Omani coastal city of Salalah, and several countries have already agreed to attend.

Iran has repeatedly stated that the Hormuz Strait will remain closed until the United States stops its blockade and attacks on Iranian ports. The Iranian military also warned that any unauthorized vessels attempting to use the waterway will be attacked or placed on a sanctions list.

The vital oil‑transport route is being severely disrupted, and at the same time the escalating conflict between Yemen’s Houthis and Saudi Arabia threatens the supply through another key passage, the Bab el‑Mandeb Strait.

Iran and Oman hinted in August that they were close to reaching an agreement to reopen shipping through the Hormuz Strait, but any deal would likely need U.S. approval as Washington continues its maritime blockade of Iran.

The United States and Iran have seen several of the most serious shipping attacks since the war began in February, sending international oil prices soaring and showing little sign of de‑escalation. The U.S. essentially opposes any Iran‑Oman agreement that does not involve America and has warned other Gulf states not to negotiate with Iran.

items.title: 〈陸股盤後〉滬指連二黑 失守三千九大關 周線收跌1.07%
items.title_en: <China Stocks After Hours> Shanghai Index Falls for Second Consecutive Day, Slides Below 3,900 Points; Weekly Close Down 1.07%
paras: 中國A股三大指數周五(11日)開低走低，連續第2個交易日收黑，上證指數(SSEC)跌破3900點大關，本周累計跌幅1.07%，主要因為投資人對美國進一步升息的預期升溫，對市場情緒構成壓力。
滬指周五收低1.18%至3888.11點；深證成指(SZI)收低1.08%至13471.26點，創業板指收跌0.49%至3322.04點，滬深兩市成交額人民幣1.97兆元，較前一交易日放量3248億元。
盤面上，多元金融全天低迷，翠微股、新力金融跌停，香溢融通、南華期貨、海德股跌幅居前；工業金屬族群重挫，北方銅業、精藝股跌停；農化製品、證券、零售、貴金屬、磷化工等板塊跌幅居前。
上漲族群方面，零件類股午後拉升，超聲電子出現本周第3根漲停板，崇達技術、駿亞科技、嘉立創、博敏電子漲停；軍工族群探底回升，光電股份、內蒙一機漲停；MLCC族群午後走強，風華高科、雙星新材漲停；電力族群逆勢活躍，閩東電力連3日亮燈，杭州熱電、江蘇新能漲停。此外，玻璃玻纖、銅纜高速連接概念等族群漲幅亦居前。
根據Wind統計數據，滬深兩市及北交所共639檔個股上漲，4864檔下跌，平盤48家。另據大智慧VIP，滬深北三市共52檔股票漲幅在9%以上，49檔股票跌幅在9%以上。
中信證券表示，7月回檔後科技股擁擠與估值壓力邊際緩解，半年報業績高增持續消化估值，行情由估值驅動轉向獲利驅動。AI算力鏈(記憶體、PCB/CCL、光通訊、AI伺服器等）貢獻大部分增量，國產算力、半導體設備、AI應用、AI終端等環節成長可期。

海通國際證券執委會委員、股票研究部主管及首席經濟學家張憶東表示，一方面，繼續看好AI科技行情的基本面，看好中國經濟新動能，A股當前配置吸引力高；另一方面，海外資金面9月可望否極泰來，美債10年期殖利率衝到5%左右之後有望回落，中國政策面特別是股市政策有望更加積極，因此，9月將迎來反轉向上，建議9月逢低佈局秋季行情。秋季行情將是從AI硬體行情進一步擴散，應擁抱以AI應用賦能千行百業為主導的新投資邏輯，沿兩條主線展開行情：一是TMT行情，既包括從主題投資走向業績驗證，也包括AI產業邏輯從側重基礎設施轉向側重應用；二是「非AI科技」方向擴散，資源、能源、農業、金融等非AI科技行業的硬核資產有望「老樹開新花」，地方國企圍繞「資本市場投融資改革+地方政府化債」而迎來併購重組或資產注入的外延式增長，都將實現價值重估。
東吳證券首席策略分析師陳剛則說，當前市場縮量具備鮮明的結構性特徵，核心驅動來自泛AI科技賽道交易熱度階段性退潮，相關板塊、槓桿交易同步降溫，疊加主動權益基金對電子、通信方向減倉，成長族群資金出現階段性收斂。此外，今年中秋節與國慶相距較近，根據2016年至2025年樣本，市場成交額會從國慶假期前第20個交易日開始逐步萎縮，整體收縮水準約25%。
paras_en: China's three major A‑share indexes opened lower on Friday (the 11th) and fell throughout the session, marking a second consecutive trading day of losses. The Shanghai Composite Index (SSEC) slipped below the 3,900‑point threshold, delivering a cumulative weekly decline of 1.07% mainly because investors’ expectations of further U.S. rate hikes have intensified, weighing on market sentiment.

The Shanghai Composite closed down 1.18% at 3,888.11 points on Friday; the Shenzhen Component Index (SZI) fell 1.08% to 13,471.26 points, and the ChiNext Index dropped 0.49% to 3,322.04 points. Turnover in the Shanghai‑Shenzhen markets reached RMB 1.97 trillion, up RMB 324.8 billion from the previous trading day.

On the market board, diversified finance stocks were weak all day, with Cuiwei and Xinli Finance hitting their daily limits down, while Xiangyi Rongtong, Nanhua Futures and Haide stocks posted the biggest declines. Industrial metals suffered heavy losses, with Northern Copper and Jingyi stocks hitting limit‑down. Agricultural chemicals, securities, retail, precious metals and phosphate chemicals were among the sectors with the largest drops.

Among the gainers, component stocks rallied in the afternoon, with Ultrasonic Electronics posting its third limit‑up of the week, and Chongda Technology, Junya Technology, Jialichuang and Bomin Electronics also hitting limit‑up. Defense stocks rebounded from lows, with Optoelectronics Co. and Inner Mongolia First Machinery reaching limit‑up. The MLCC sector strengthened in the afternoon, with Fenghua High‑Tech and Shuangxing New Materials hitting limit‑up. Power stocks were active against the trend, with Min Dong Power lighting up for the third consecutive day, and Hangzhou Thermal Power and Jiangsu New Energy also hitting limit‑up. In addition, glass‑fiber, high‑speed copper cable and related concepts posted notable gains.

According to Wind data, a total of 639 stocks across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchanges rose, 4,864 fell and 48 were unchanged. Data from Dazhihui VIP shows that across the three markets, 52 stocks gained more than 9% while 49 stocks lost more than 9%.

CITIC Securities said that after the July pull‑back, the crowding and valuation pressure on technology stocks has eased marginally, and the strong earnings growth in half‑year reports continues to digest valuations, shifting market drivers from valuation‑based to profit‑based. The AI compute chain (memory, PCB/CCL, optical communication, AI servers, etc.) contributed most of the incremental growth, and domestic compute power, semiconductor equipment, AI applications and AI end‑devices are expected to see solid growth.

Hai Tong International Securities Executive Committee member, head of equity research and chief economist Zhang Yidong noted that on the one hand, the fundamentals of the AI technology rally remain strong and China’s new economic drivers are promising, making current A‑share allocation attractive. On the other hand, overseas capital may turn around in September as the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield, after spiking to around 5%, is likely to retreat, and Chinese policy—especially stock‑market policy—could become more proactive. He expects a September reversal upward and advises building positions in the autumn market on dips. The autumn rally is expected to spread from AI hardware to broader AI‑enabled industries, following two main lines: TMT, moving from thematic investing to earnings validation and shifting AI focus from infrastructure to applications; and a “non‑AI tech” expansion, where hard‑asset sectors such as resources, energy, agriculture and finance could see “new blossoms on old trees,” with local state‑owned enterprises driving M&A, restructuring or asset injections under capital‑market financing reforms and local‑government debt‑to‑equity swaps, leading to value re‑rating.

Dongwu Securities chief strategy analyst Chen Gang said the current market, characterized by reduced volume, shows a clear structural pattern: the core driver is a temporary cooling of trading enthusiasm in the broad AI‑tech arena, with related sectors and leveraged trades also cooling, compounded by active‑equity funds cutting exposure to electronics and communications, causing a short‑term pull‑back of growth‑sector capital. Moreover, with the Mid‑Autumn Festival and National Day holidays close together this year, historical data from 2016‑2025 suggests that market turnover will start to shrink from the 20th trading day before the National Day holiday, contracting overall by roughly 25%.

items.title: 日本8月PPI年增7.6%高於預期 鞏固央行9月升息預期
items.title_en: Japan August PPI Up 7.6% YoY, Exceeding Expectations, Reinforcing September Rate Hike Outlook
paras: 日本央行最新公布數據顯示，日本8月批發物價指數(PPI)持續處於高位，年增率超出市場預期，顯示通膨壓力居高不下，進一步鞏固了日本央行於本月升息的合理性。
根據日本央行資料，8月批發物價指數較去年同期上漲7.6%，高於市場預期的7.4%，僅較7月修正後的7.7%(自2023年2月以來新高)略微放緩。按月計算，8月指數微幅下降0.2%。
推動物價上漲的主要項目包括石油與煤炭製品、化學製品、資訊通訊設備及有色金屬。此外，8月以日元計價的進口物價指數年增24.8%，顯示日元疲軟顯著推升了進口成本與廣義通膨。
受到中東衝突推升燃料成本，以及勞動力市場緊繃帶動工資上漲等影響，企業在能源、運輸與包裝等進貨成本上面臨持續壓力，並試圖將其轉嫁給消費者。日本央行總裁植田和男強調，正密切觀察批發物價變化，評估企業將成本轉嫁給家庭的程度。
日本央行已於6月將利率調升至31年來高點的1%。隨著通膨與日元疲軟疑慮持續，市場已幾乎完全消化央行將於9月18日會議上升息25個基點至1.25%的預期，分析師更預估基準利率可能於2027年第二季，進一步調升至1.75%。
paras_en: Japan's central bank released the latest data showing that Japan's August wholesale price index (PPI) remained at a high level, with a year‑over‑year increase that surpassed market expectations, indicating persistent inflation pressure and further bolstering the case for a rate hike this month by the Bank of Japan.

According to Bank of Japan data, the August wholesale price index rose 7.6% from the same month last year, above the market forecast of 7.4% and only slightly slower than the revised 7.7% in July, a peak not seen since February 2023. On a month‑over‑month basis, the index slipped 0.2% in August.

The main drivers of price increases were oil and coal products, chemicals, information and communications equipment, and non‑ferrous metals. In addition, the import price index priced in yen rose 24.8% year‑over‑year in August, showing that a weak yen significantly lifted import costs and broad‑based inflation.

Fuel costs have been pushed up by the Middle East conflict and a tight labour market has driven wage growth, leaving firms under continued pressure on input costs for energy, transport and packaging, which they are trying to pass on to consumers. Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that the bank is closely monitoring wholesale price movements and assessing the extent to which companies shift costs onto households.

The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1% in June, the highest level in 31 years. With inflation and yen weakness persisting, the market has almost fully priced in a 25‑basis‑point hike to 1.25% at the September 18 meeting, and analysts project the benchmark rate could be lifted further to 1.75% in the second quarter of 2027.

items.title: 大摩看空Nike 目標價僅31美元、華爾街最低
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Bears Nike, Sets $31 Target – Wall Street Low
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，Nike(NKE-US)近期股價表現艱難，而摩根士丹利分析師認為，情況可能進一步惡化。
摩根士丹利周四(10日)重新開始追蹤Nike股票，並給予「減碼」(underweight)評級，同時設定31美元的目標價，為華爾街最低，遠低於Visible Alpha約48美元的市場共識。
Nike股價周四收盤下跌約2%，跌至12年來新低，低於37美元。
Visible Alpha追蹤的另外13位分析師中，僅有1位建議賣出Nike股票，另有10位給予「中立」評級，2位給予「買進」評級。
摩根士丹利表示，市場對Nike的共識預測「在太短時間內反映了過多成長預期，尤其是在中國市場」，並指出宏觀經濟逆風及競爭疑慮。分析師認為，Nike目前估值與「日益分化」的運動服飾市場現況並不相符。
這家服飾製造商距離執行長Elliott Hill於2024年底接任職務即將滿兩年。公司也在今年8月迎來新任財務長。
分析師表示，財務長人事異動，加上整體運動服飾市場面臨「壓力」，可能讓Nike即將於10月公布的財報，或11月舉行的年度投資人日，成為公司「重新設定市場預期」的良好時機，尤其是針對轉型速度的預期。
周四股價下跌後，Nike今年以來累計跌幅已超過40%。
paras_en: Investopedia reports that Nike (NKE-US) has been struggling recently, and Morgan Stanley analysts say the situation could worsen further.

Morgan Stanley resumed coverage of Nike on Thursday (the 10th), assigning an underweight rating and setting a $31 price target, the lowest on Wall Street and well below the roughly $48 market consensus tracked by Visible Alpha.
Nike’s stock closed down about 2% on Thursday, hitting a 12‑year low below $37.
Among the 13 other analysts tracked by Visible Alpha, only one recommends selling Nike, ten rate it neutral and two give it a buy rating.

Morgan Stanley says the market’s consensus forecast for Nike “reflects too much growth expectation in a short time, especially in China,” and points to macroeconomic headwinds and competitive concerns. The analysts argue Nike’s current valuation does not match the increasingly fragmented athletic apparel market.
The apparel maker is approaching the two‑year mark since CEO Elliott Hill took over at the end of 2024, and it welcomed a new CFO in August this year.

The analysts note that the CFO change, combined with pressure on the overall athletic apparel market, could make Nike’s earnings due in October or its annual investor day in November a good opportunity to reset market expectations, especially regarding the pace of its transformation.
After Thursday’s drop, Nike has fallen more than 40% year‑to‑date.

items.title: BOJ下周傳升息1碼！基準利率衝1.25%創31年新高 恐釋加速緊縮訊號
items.title_en: BOJ Expected to Raise Rates by 1 Basis Point Next Week! Benchmark Rate Hits 1.25% – 31-Year High, Signaling Accelerated Tightening
paras: 路透引述四名知情人士說法報導，日本銀行(BOJ, 央行)可望在下周升息，最可能升息1碼(25個基點)，且若物價壓力升高、通膨超標風險加劇，日銀可能釋出未來加速緊縮的訊號。
若日銀真如此消息把升息至1.25%，基準利率將攀抵31年來最高水準。這也將代表日銀在6月升息只過三個月就再次升息，形同緊縮步調加快，特別是考量到日銀可能釋出年底前再次升息的訊號。
許多日銀官員認為，再次升息的條件正逐步成熟，國內經濟有望溫和復甦，物價壓力也正在升高。知情人士則透露，即使日銀升息至1.25%，金融環境預料仍將保持寬鬆。
他們指出，日元近期回升之後，可能在抑制進口成本漲幅的情況下，緩解物價壓力，但日元前一段時間已經大幅貶值，加上燃料價格恢復上漲，仍將使日銀對通膨風險保持警戒。
日銀在6月將利率升至1%，並承諾若經濟與物價發展符合基礎預測情境，將進一步推高借貸升息。
日銀在7月會議上維持利率不變，但警告中東衝突、日元疲弱以及強勁的人工智慧(AI)相關需求正在加劇物價壓力，可能造成通膨超標風險，讓外界解讀近期升息可能性很高。
路透調查的分析師預期，日銀將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息至1.25%，明年3月底前升至1.5%，接著在2027年第2季升至1.75%。多數分析師認為，終端利率至少為1.75%。
9月之後，日銀將於10月、12月以及明年1月召開決策會議。
由於市場已完全反映9月升息預期，部分市場人士大膽押注日銀可能意外升息2碼(50個基點)，以帶來更大的驚喜。但由於目前沒有薪資與物價成長突然加速的迫切風險，知情人士表示，日銀下周可能仍會選擇常見的升息1碼，並等待更多數據，以判斷是否有必要再次升息。
日銀理事增一行(Kazuyuki Masu)周四表示，「核心通膨即將達到2%，但我們看不到大幅超過這一水準的情況」，這番話顯示他認為目前沒有通膨即將急遽飆升的跡象，因此下周沒有必要大幅升息。

終端利率沒有預設值

市場正關注日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)會後記者會的訊號，包括未來升息步調，以及日銀在本輪緊縮周期中利率可能升至多高。
知情人士表示，日銀可能沒有預設的終端利率，最終水準將取決於過去升息對經濟的影響，以及企業把成本上升轉嫁給家庭的程度。
日銀內部對升息速度也沒有共識，鷹派認為核心通膨已達2%，但也有反對6月升息的鴿派人士存在。
因此，知情人士表示，植田和男將避免給出有關未來升息的具體時間表，但可能重申7月的說法，也就是認為在金融環境過於寬鬆的情況下，日銀可能加快升息步調。
自7月底美日聯手干預匯市以來，日元已升值逾6%，儘管日元升值原本預料能引導進口成本下降的效果，但布蘭特原油本周重返每桶100美元之上，抵銷了日元升值帶來的效應，也讓人擔憂通膨壓力重新升高。
paras_en: Reuters quoted four insiders saying the Bank of Japan (BOJ, the central bank) is likely to raise rates next week, most probably by 1 basis point (25 basis points), and if inflationary pressures rise and the risk of inflation exceeding targets increases, the BOJ may signal a future acceleration of tightening.

If the BOJ indeed raises rates to 1.25%, the benchmark rate would reach its highest level in 31 years. This would also mean the BOJ would raise rates again just three months after the June hike, effectively speeding up the tightening pace, especially considering the possibility of another rate hike before year‑end.

Many BOJ officials believe the conditions for a second hike are gradually maturing, the domestic economy is expected to recover moderately, and price pressures are rising. Insiders say that even if the BOJ raises rates to 1.25%, the financial environment is expected to remain accommodative.

They pointed out that after the yen recently appreciated, it may help curb import cost increases and ease price pressures, but the yen had previously depreciated sharply, and with fuel prices rebounding, the BOJ will remain vigilant about inflation risks.
The BOJ raised rates to 1% in June and pledged to further lift borrowing costs if the economy and price developments align with its baseline forecast.

At the July meeting, the BOJ kept rates unchanged but warned that the Middle East conflict, a weak yen, and strong AI‑related demand are intensifying price pressures, potentially raising the risk of inflation exceeding targets, leading observers to interpret a high likelihood of a recent rate hike.

Analysts surveyed by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise rates to 1.25% at the September 17‑18 meeting, to 1.5% by the end of March next year, and then to 1.75% in Q2 2027. Most analysts believe the terminal rate will be at least 1.75%.
After September, the BOJ will hold decision meetings in October, December, and January next year.

Because the market has fully priced in the September hike, some market participants boldly bet that the BOJ might unexpectedly raise rates by 2 basis points (50 basis points) for a bigger surprise. However, since there is no urgent risk of sudden wage and price growth acceleration, insiders say the BOJ may still choose the usual 1‑basis‑point hike next week and wait for more data to decide whether another hike is necessary.

BOJ board member Kazuyuki Masu said on Thursday, "Core inflation is about to reach 2%, but we do not see a large overshoot of this level," indicating he sees no signs of a sudden inflation surge, so a large hike next week is unnecessary.
The market is watching the signals from BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda at the post‑meeting press conference, including the pace of future hikes and how high rates could rise in this tightening cycle.
Insiders say the BOJ may not have a preset terminal rate; the final level will depend on the impact of past hikes on the economy and how much firms pass cost increases onto households.
There is no consensus within the BOJ on the pace of hikes; hawks believe core inflation has reached 2%, but there are also dovish voices who opposed the June hike.

Therefore, insiders say Ueda will avoid giving a specific timetable for future hikes but may reiterate July’s stance, namely that in an overly accommodative financial environment the BOJ could accelerate the pace of hikes.

Since the joint US‑Japan intervention in the FX market at the end of July, the yen has appreciated over 6%. Although the yen’s appreciation was expected to lower import costs, Brent crude returned above $100 a barrel this week, offsetting the effect of the yen’s appreciation and raising concerns that inflationary pressure may rise again.

items.title: 〈台幣〉買匯避險升溫 爆量貶值9分收31.638元
items.title_en: TWD Hedging Demand Rises, Massive Volume, Depreciates 0.09 to Close at 31.638
paras: 在國際油價攀升、美國升息壓力升溫的衝擊下，台北股匯市重挫，買匯避險力道湧現，新台幣今(11)日全日處貶值態勢，最低一度逼近31.7元價位，終場收在31.638元，貶值9分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值暴出29.38億美元天量。
新台幣今日以31.58元、貶值3.2分開出後，越走越低，午盤後開出全日最低價31.698元，買匯力道相當強勁，收盤前一小時貶值壓力才緩步收斂，高低價差1.18角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元反而強彈超過0.4%，日元升值0.2%，泰銖、人民幣和星元微幅升值，新台幣最弱勢，收貶0.29%。

paras_en: Amid rising international oil prices and mounting pressure for U.S. rate hikes, Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets suffered sharp declines, prompting a surge in demand for TWD hedging. The New Taiwan dollar was on a depreciation trend throughout the day, briefly approaching the 31.7 per dollar level, and ultimately closed at 31.638, down 0.09. items.title: BOJ下周傳升息1碼！基準利率衝1.25%創31年新高 恐釋加速緊縮訊號
items.title_en: BOJ Expected to Raise Rates by 1 Basis Point Next Week! Benchmark Rate Hits 1.25% – 31-Year High, Signaling Accelerated Tightening
paras: 路透引述四名知情人士說法報導，日本銀行(BOJ, 央行)可望在下周升息，最可能升息1碼(25個基點)，且若物價壓力升高、通膨超標風險加劇，日銀可能釋出未來加速緊縮的訊號。
若日銀真如此消息把升息至1.25%，基準利率將攀抵31年來最高水準。這也將代表日銀在6月升息只過三個月就再次升息，形同緊縮步調加快，特別是考量到日銀可能釋出年底前再次升息的訊號。
許多日銀官員認為，再次升息的條件正逐步成熟，國內經濟有望溫和復甦，物價壓力也正在升高。知情人士則透露，即使日銀升息至1.25%，金融環境預料仍將保持寬鬆。
他們指出，日元近期回升之後，可能在抑制進口成本漲幅的情況下，緩解物價壓力，但日元前一段時間已經大幅貶值，加上燃料價格恢復上漲，仍將使日銀對通膨風險保持警戒。
日銀在6月將利率升至1%，並承諾若經濟與物價發展符合基礎預測情境，將進一步推高借貸升息。
日銀在7月會議上維持利率不變，但警告中東衝突、日元疲弱以及強勁的人工智慧(AI)相關需求正在加劇物價壓力，可能造成通膨超標風險，讓外界解讀近期升息可能性很高。
路透調查的分析師預期，日銀將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息至1.25%，明年3月底前升至1.5%，接著在2027年第2季升至1.75%。多數分析師認為，終端利率至少為1.75%。
9月之後，日銀將於10月、12月以及明年1月召開決策會議。
由於市場已完全反映9月升息預期，部分市場人士大膽押注日銀可能意外升息2碼(50個基點)，以帶來更大的驚喜。但由於目前沒有薪資與物價成長突然加速的迫切風險，知情人士表示，日銀下周可能仍會選擇常見的升息1碼，並等待更多數據，以判斷是否有必要再次升息。
日銀理事增一行(Kazuyuki Masu)周四表示，「核心通膨即將達到2%，但我們看不到大幅超過這一水準的情況」，這番話顯示他認為目前沒有通膨即將急遽飆升的跡象，因此下周沒有必要大幅升息。

終端利率沒有預設值

市場正關注日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)會後記者會的訊號，包括未來升息步調，以及日銀在本輪緊縮周期中利率可能升至多高。
知情人士表示，日銀可能沒有預設的終端利率，最終水準將取決於過去升息對經濟的影響，以及企業把成本上升轉嫁給家庭的程度。
日銀內部對升息速度也沒有共識，鷹派認為核心通膨已達2%，但也有反對6月升息的鴿派人士存在。
因此，知情人士表示，植田和男將避免給出有關未來升息的具體時間表，但可能重申7月的說法，也就是認為在金融環境過於寬鬆的情況下，日銀可能加快升息步調。
自7月底美日聯手干預匯市以來，日元已升值逾6%，儘管日元升值原本預料能引導進口成本下降的效果，但布蘭特原油本周重返每桶100美元之上，抵銷了日元升值帶來的效應，也讓人擔憂通膨壓力重新升高。
paras_en: Reuters quoted four insiders saying the Bank of Japan (BOJ, the central bank) is likely to raise rates next week, most probably by 1 basis point (25 basis points), and if inflationary pressures rise and the risk of inflation exceeding targets increases, the BOJ may signal a future acceleration of tightening.

If the BOJ indeed raises rates to 1.25%, the benchmark rate would reach its highest level in 31 years. This would also mean the BOJ would raise rates again just three months after the June hike, effectively speeding up the tightening pace, especially considering the possibility of another rate hike before year‑end.

Many BOJ officials believe the conditions for a second hike are gradually maturing, the domestic economy is expected to recover moderately, and price pressures are rising. Insiders say that even if the BOJ raises rates to 1.25%, the financial environment is expected to remain accommodative.

They pointed out that after the yen recently appreciated, it may help curb import cost increases and ease price pressures, but the yen had previously depreciated sharply, and with fuel prices rebounding, the BOJ will remain vigilant about inflation risks.
The BOJ raised rates to 1% in June and pledged to further lift borrowing costs if the economy and price developments align with its baseline forecast.

At the July meeting, the BOJ kept rates unchanged but warned that the Middle East conflict, a weak yen, and strong AI‑related demand are intensifying price pressures, potentially raising the risk of inflation exceeding targets, leading observers to interpret a high likelihood of a recent rate hike.

Analysts surveyed by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise rates to 1.25% at the September 17‑18 meeting, to 1.5% by the end of March next year, and then to 1.75% in Q2 2027. Most analysts believe the terminal rate will be at least 1.75%.
After September, the BOJ will hold decision meetings in October, December, and January next year.

Because the market has fully priced in the September hike, some market participants boldly bet that the BOJ might unexpectedly raise rates by 2 basis points (50 basis points) for a bigger surprise. However, since there is no urgent risk of sudden wage and price growth acceleration, insiders say the BOJ may still choose the usual 1‑basis‑point hike next week and wait for more data to decide whether another hike is necessary.

BOJ board member Kazuyuki Masu said on Thursday, "Core inflation is about to reach 2%, but we do not see a large overshoot of this level," indicating he sees no signs of a sudden inflation surge, so a large hike next week is unnecessary.
The market is watching the signals from BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda at the post‑meeting press conference, including the pace of future hikes and how high rates could rise in this tightening cycle.
Insiders say the BOJ may not have a preset terminal rate; the final level will depend on the impact of past hikes on the economy and how much firms pass cost increases onto households.
There is no consensus within the BOJ on the pace of hikes; hawks believe core inflation has reached 2%, but there are also dovish voices who opposed the June hike.

Therefore, insiders say Ueda will avoid giving a specific timetable for future hikes but may reiterate July’s stance, namely that in an overly accommodative financial environment the BOJ could accelerate the pace of hikes.

Since the joint US‑Japan intervention in the FX market at the end of July, the yen has appreciated over 6%. Although the yen’s appreciation was expected to lower import costs, Brent crude returned above $100 a barrel this week, offsetting the effect of the yen’s appreciation and raising concerns that inflationary pressure may rise again.

items.title: 日元近期強升非短線反彈？ 知名資管機構：低估修正啟動 回調即布局多頭
items.title_en: Yen's Recent Surge Not a Short-Term Bounce? Prominent Asset Management Firm: Undervaluation Correction Begins, Pullbacks Offer Bullish Positioning
paras: 日元近期強勢攀升，可能並非短期反彈，而是多年低估狀態進入更廣泛修正。歐洲資產管理公司Edmond de Rothschild多資產及對沖策略主管Michael Nizard最新表示，日元正擺脫長期由美日利差與套利交易主導的定價模式，重新回歸基本面。
Nizard說，「日元可能正在重新成為真正由基本面驅動的貨幣」，並稱未來回檔應視為重建，或是加碼日元多頭的機會。
本月以來日元已升值逾3%。日本央行(BOJ)加快緊縮的預期升溫，加上日本退休金資金配置可能改變，投資人紛紛平倉日元空單。美國財長貝森特此前更向交易員喊話「敢做空日元試試看」。
Nizard認為，近期美日聯合干預匯市同樣關鍵，市場原以為東京當局容忍日元貶值，聯合干預扭轉了預期，使日元貶值從「單向交易」變成漲跌風險並存的「雙向交易」。若日元續強，套利交易恐進一步平倉，槓桿下降將引發投資人拋售美債、信用債與股票；日本資金若回流國內，也將為全球債市帶來新波動。
他並提醒，修正過程不會是單方向，期間仍可能盤整甚至回弱，但只要趨勢不變，回檔都是布局多頭的機會。
基本面也出現改善。根據BOJ今(11)日公布的數據，8月企業商品價格指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於預期的7.4%，略低於7月修正後的7.7%，但月減0.2%。數據顯示，日企仍面臨能源、運輸、包裝與工資成本壓力，最終可能轉嫁消費者，推升通膨風險。
目前，市場普遍預估BOJ下周五(18日)將升息1碼至1.25%。
paras_en: The yen's recent strong climb may not be a short‑term rebound but rather a broader correction as it moves out of years of undervaluation. Michael Nizard, head of multi‑asset and hedge‑fund strategies at European asset manager Edmond de Rothschild, said the yen is shedding the pricing model long dominated by US‑Japan interest‑rate differentials and arbitrage trades, and is returning to fundamentals.

Nizard said, “The yen may be becoming a currency truly driven by fundamentals,” and added that any future pull‑back should be seen as a rebuilding phase, or an opportunity to add to long yen positions.

Since the start of the month the yen has appreciated by more than 3%. Expectations that the Bank of Japan will tighten faster are heating up, and possible changes in Japanese pension fund allocations are prompting investors to unwind short yen positions. U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen earlier urged traders, “If you dare to short the yen, give it a try.”

Nizard sees the recent joint US‑Japan intervention in the FX market as equally pivotal. The market had assumed Tokyo tolerated yen depreciation; the coordinated intervention flipped that expectation, turning yen weakness from a one‑way trade into a two‑way trade with both upside and downside risk. If the yen keeps strengthening, arbitrage positions are likely to be further unwound, reduced leverage could trigger investors to sell U.S. Treasuries, credit bonds and equities; a repatriation of Japanese capital would also introduce new volatility to global bond markets.

He cautioned that the correction will not be unidirectional; there may be periods of consolidation or even temporary weakness, but as long as the trend remains intact, each pull‑back is an opportunity to build long positions.

Fundamentals are also improving. According to data released by the BOJ today (Nov 11), the August corporate goods price index (CGPI) rose 7.6% year‑on‑year, above the 7.4% forecast, slightly below the revised July figure of 7.7%, and fell 0.2% month‑on‑month. The data show Japanese firms still face pressure from energy, transport, packaging and wage costs, which could eventually be passed on to consumers, raising inflation risks.
Currently the market broadly expects the BOJ to raise rates by one basis point to 1.25% on Friday, the 18th.

items.title: 日元漲勢是曇花一現？巴克萊點出兩大利多可能落空
items.title_en: Is the Yen’s Rally a Flash in the Pan? Barclays Flags Two Potential Bullish Catalysts May Miss
paras: 巴克萊表示，如果市場對日本央行加快升息，以及日本退休基金將資金轉向國內資產的預期未能實現，日元近期的急升走勢可能逆轉，兌美元恐回落至150區間高檔。
包括Shinichiro Kadota在內的策略師周四(10日)在報告中指出，日元近期走強，主要受到日本央行收緊貨幣政策的預期、退休基金資金流向的揣測，以及技術面因素推動。儘管美元兌日元跌破155附近的關鍵支撐，短期仍可能進一步走低，但長期壓抑日元的結構性因素大致未變。
日元本月迄今已上漲近4%，升至2月以來最強水準，市場看多情緒持續升溫。投資人對日本央行下周升息的預期增強，加上外界猜測日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能提高日本國內資產配置，進一步帶動日元需求。
美國財長貝森特也向交易員喊話，挑戰市場測試他推升日元的決心，並表示自己「相當清楚」日本決策官員接下來會採取什麼行動。
亞洲周四下午交易時段，日元小幅升值0.1%，報每美元兌153.45日元。
巴克萊警告，市場預期目前已處於高檔，若日元要進一步升值，日本央行可能必須釋出比預期更鷹派的訊號。市場也可能高估GPIF資金流向的潛在影響，若其資產配置最終未出現調整，日元恐面臨走勢逆轉。
此外，巴克萊指出，利差、日本股票風險溢價、外界對首相高市早苗政策的疑慮，以及結構性的日元賣盤，仍不利於日元持續升值。
paras_en: Barclays says that if market expectations of a faster rate‑hike cycle by the Bank of Japan and of Japanese pension funds shifting money into domestic assets fail to materialise, the yen’s recent sharp rise could reverse, with the dollar‑yen possibly slipping back into the high‑150s range.

Strategists, including Shinichiro Kadota, noted on Thursday (the 10th) that the yen’s recent strength has been driven mainly by expectations of tighter BOJ policy, speculation about pension fund flows and technical factors. Even though USD/JPY has broken below the key support near 155, it could still drift lower in the short term, but the structural headwinds that keep the yen subdued remain largely unchanged.

The yen is up almost 4% so far this month, reaching its strongest level since February, as bullish sentiment heats up. Investors’ expectations of a BOJ rate hike next week have risen, and speculation that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may increase its allocation to domestic assets is further boosting yen demand.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen also called out traders, challenging the market to test her resolve to support the yen, and said she is “quite clear” about what Japanese policymakers are likely to do next.
In the Asian afternoon trading session on Thursday, the yen edged up 0.1% to 153.45 per dollar.

Barclays warns that market expectations are already at elevated levels; for the yen to rise further the BOJ may need to signal a more hawkish stance than anticipated. The market may also be over‑estimating the impact of GPIF flows, and if the fund’s asset allocation does not adjust, the yen could see its rally reverse.

Barclays also points out that interest‑rate differentials, risk premiums on Japanese equities, concerns about Prime Minister Kishida’s policies, and structural yen‑selling pressure remain headwinds to any sustained yen appreciation.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 PPI推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Rises as PPI Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周四(10日)上漲，美國年度整體生產者通膨加速，推升聯準會(Fed)升息預期。數據公布後，債券市場跌勢進一步加劇，殖利率大幅攀升，也進一步推高借貸成本。
同時，歐洲央行(ECB)如市場普遍預期升息後，歐元走弱。另一方面，市場預期日本銀行(BoJ)即將收緊貨幣政策，日元此前猛烈漲勢也暫告停歇。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報99.03。
匯市投資人周四焦點集中在美國8月生產者物價指數(PPI)報告。
根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)數據，8月整體PPI月增0.4%、年增5.4%，分別高於市場預期的0.4%與5.3%。此外，7月整體PPI也從原先月增0.1%、年增4.7%，上修至月增0.1%、年增4.8%。
核心PPI則月增0.2%、年增4.6%，市場原先預期分別為月增0.3%與年增4.6%。
PPI報告公布後一天，市場還將迎來受到更高度關注的消費者物價指數(CPI)數據，而就在幾天前，美國才公布表現強勁的8月非農就業報告。綜合這些指標來看，美國勞動市場依然具韌性，同時經濟也受到價格壓力困擾。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策。
這種預期也反映在聯準會利率機率上。根據CME FedWatch工具，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)9月16日升息25個基點的機率，目前已升至73%，高於PPI數據公布前的約64%。
PPI數據公布後，美股走低，美國公債殖利率同步上升，債券遭到拋售。10年期美債殖利率最新上升11.8個基點至4.955%，對利率更加敏感的2年期美債殖利率則上升12.9個基點，至4.556%。
債券市場前一個交易日同樣大幅走弱，因市場高度期待的美國財政部國債回購計畫更新，最終令投資人失望。
此外，油價漲勢周四進一步擴大，加劇市場對通膨的擔憂。美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨價格突破每桶100美元，為5月21日以來首次。油價上漲主要受到美國與伊朗軍事衝突重新升溫推動，雙方此前曾因荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)控制權問題陷入數周僵局。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「與伊朗的戰事正在壓過華府的債券回購努力，因為不斷升高的通膨預期，對區區60億美元的回購規模而言，負擔實在太沉重。」
他表示，「白宮與財政部本身都希望利率下降，但與德黑蘭的衝突升溫，不利於油價穩定與國家預算，因為區域內的暴力攻擊正在干擾原油供應，並推高軍事支出，進而在其他條件不變下擴大財政缺口。」
「此外，這也讓聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)陷入兩難，因固定收益市場實際上正要求聯準會升息，以壓制正在加速的價格壓力。」
ECB升息 日元漲勢暫歇
歐洲央行周四如市場普遍預期，將主要政策利率上調25個基點，並指出中東衝突導致能源價格上漲，持續帶來通膨壓力。
央行在聲明中警告，中東衝突持續「產生通膨壓力」，而通膨率預計將在「一段較長時間內」明顯高於2%的政策目標。
德意志銀行首席歐洲經濟學家Mark Wall表示，「通膨風險可能正在升高，12月進一步升息的可能性或許已經高於不升息，但歐洲央行仍需謹慎行事。過去6個月經濟表現具韌性，但天然氣價格快速上漲意味著負面的供給衝擊正在累積。這最終將傷害經濟成長，問題在於衝擊會有多大，以及何時發生。」
歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)在會後記者會上表示，由伊朗戰爭造成的「能源衝擊」可能進一步加劇，而且對其他商品價格與工資造成的第二輪影響，可能比預期更強。
《彭博》引述知情人士報導，歐洲央行官員預計將進一步升息，最快可能在下個月。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1614美元。
日元周四暫停近期強勁的升值走勢，美元兌日元上漲0.6%，至154.34日元。不過，隨著交易員持續拆解日元利差交易空頭部位，日元仍穩守在7個月高點附近。
貨幣市場普遍預期，日銀將於9月18日升息25個基點。這項預期受到日本第2季GDP成長率上修至1.4%，以及進口通膨維持高位等因素支持。
在官方數據顯示日本8月外國證券持有量創紀錄減少878億美元、用於支應匯市干預操作後，市場對東京匯率政策的關注依然高度升溫，其中包括近期與華府同步進行的一項歷史性干預行動。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Thursday (the 10th), as the U.S. annual overall producer price inflation accelerated, lifting expectations for another Federal Reserve rate hike. After the data were released, the bond market fell further, yields surged sharply and borrowing costs rose.

At the same time, the euro weakened after the European Central Bank, as the market broadly expected, raised rates. Conversely, the market expects the Bank of Japan to tighten policy soon, pausing the yen’s recent sharp rally.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.2% at 99.03.
FX investors on Thursday focused on the U.S. August producer price index (PPI) report.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, August overall PPI rose 0.4% month‑on‑month and 5.4% year‑on‑year, both above market expectations of 0.4% and 5.3%. In addition, July overall PPI was revised from a 0.1% monthly gain and 4.7% annual gain to a 0.1% monthly gain and 4.8% annual gain.
Core PPI rose 0.2% month‑on‑month and 4.6% year‑on‑year, versus market expectations of a 0.3% monthly rise and a 4.6% annual rise.

One day after the PPI release, the market will also receive the highly‑watched consumer price index (CPI) data, and just days earlier the U.S. posted a strong August non‑farm payroll report. Taken together, these indicators show that the U.S. labor market remains resilient while the economy is still under price pressure. In such a setting, central banks typically consider tightening monetary policy.

That expectation is reflected in Fed rate‑move probabilities. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the odds of a 25‑basis‑point hike by the Federal Open Market Committee on September 16 have risen to 73%, up from roughly 64% before the PPI data were released.

After the PPI numbers, U.S. equities fell and Treasury yields rose as bonds were sold off. The 10‑year Treasury yield climbed 11.8 basis points to 4.955%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield jumped 12.9 basis points to 4.556%.
The bond market also weakened sharply the previous trading day, after an update to the highly anticipated U.S. Treasury repurchase program disappointed investors.

In addition, oil prices rose further on Thursday, heightening inflation concerns. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures broke the $100‑a‑barrel mark for the first time since May 21. The price gain was driven mainly by a renewed flare‑up in U.S.–Iran military tensions, after both sides spent weeks deadlocked over control of the Strait of Hormuz.

José Torres, a senior economist at Interactive Brokers, said, “The conflict with Iran is outweighing Washington’s bond‑buyback efforts, because the rising inflation expectations make even a $6 billion repurchase program a heavy burden.”

He added, “Both the White House and the Treasury want rates to fall, but the escalating clash with Tehran hurts oil‑price stability and the national budget, as regional violence disrupts crude supply and pushes up military spending, widening the fiscal gap all else equal.”
“Moreover, this puts Fed Chair Kevin Warsh in a bind, because the fixed‑income market is effectively demanding a rate hike to curb accelerating price pressures.”
ECB Rate Hike, Yen Rally Pauses

On Thursday, the European Central Bank, as broadly expected, lifted its main policy rate by 25 basis points and noted that Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price gains continue to feed inflation pressure.

In its statement, the ECB warned that the ongoing Middle‑East conflict is “creating inflationary pressure,” and that inflation is expected to stay “significantly above the 2% target for a prolonged period.”

Mark Wall, chief European economist at Deutsche Bank, said, “Inflation risks may be rising, and the odds of a further hike in December could now be higher than of holding steady, but the ECB must act prudently. The economy has shown resilience over the past six months, yet the rapid rise in gas prices signals a negative supply shock that is building up. That will ultimately hurt growth; the question is how large the shock will be and when it will hit.”

ECB President Christine Lagarde told reporters after the meeting that the “energy shock” from the Iran war could intensify further, and the second‑round effects on other commodity prices and wages may be stronger than expected.
Bloomberg, citing informed sources, reported that ECB officials expect to raise rates again, possibly as early as next month.
The euro fell 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1614.

The yen halted its recent strong appreciation on Thursday, with the dollar‑yen pair up 0.6% at 154.34 yen. Nevertheless, as traders continue to unwind short positions in yen‑carry trades, the currency remains near a seven‑month high.

The money market broadly expects the BOJ to raise rates by 25 basis points on September 18. That view is supported by the revision of Japan’s Q2 GDP growth to 1.4% and persistently high import‑price inflation.

Official data showed Japan’s August foreign‑securities holdings fell by a record $87.8 billion after being used for FX‑intervention, keeping market focus on Tokyo’s policy moves, including a historic coordinated intervention with Washington.

items.title: 通膨壓不住、經濟又怕衰退！歐洲央行利率是否衝3% 分析師吵翻天
items.title_en: Inflation Unchecked, Economy Fears Recession! Will ECB Rates Hit 3%? Analysts Clash
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四(10日)如預期升息1碼(25個基點)，將存款利率調高至2.5%，為今年第二度升息，以因應美伊戰爭推升能源價格所帶來的通膨壓力。ECB雖未承諾後續行動，但分析師對本輪升息是否已近尾聲看法不一：部分認為年底前可能再度升息，另一些則警告，能源衝擊終將拖累成長，市場押注利率逼近3%可能過頭。
市場反應方面，歐元兌美元下跌0.3%至約1.159美元，歐元區公債殖利率升至多年高點，歐洲Stoxx 600指數下跌0.7%；油價則大漲逾4%至每桶105.3美元。

鷹派認為升息尚未結束 年底前可能再出手

德意志銀行(DB-US)首席歐洲經濟學家Mark Wall表示，通膨風險正在上升，ECB於12月再次升息的可能性或許已超過按兵不動。不過，ECB仍須謹慎行事，因歐元區經濟過去半年雖展現韌性，天然氣價格迅速上漲造成的負面供給衝擊正逐漸累積，最終勢必傷害成長，問題只在影響程度及何時浮現。
Saltmarsh Economics歐洲經濟學家Marchel Alexandrovich指出，ECB在三個月內第二度升息，並暗示未來幾次會議可能需要進一步緊縮。ECB雖未預先承諾升息，但最新預測顯示，2028年核心通膨仍達2.3%，高於6月預估的2.2%，意味若要讓通膨在中期回到2%目標，可能還需要繼續升息。
摩根大通私人銀行(JPMorgan Private Bank)(JPM-US)宏觀投資策略師Patrick Ernst認為，年底前再升息已不再只是低機率風險。中東衝突再次升級，推動油氣價格明顯上漲、美債遭到拋售，市場對主要央行繼續緊縮的預期也同步升高。
Ernst表示，ECB本次升息符合預期，但真正重要的是決策聲明仍為進一步緊縮保留空間，顯示能源引發的通膨風險依然存在，「這次升息並不是利率上限」，後續走向將高度取決於地緣政治局勢。
標普全球評級(S&P Global Ratings)(SPGI-US)歐洲、中東及非洲首席經濟學家Sylvain Broyer也表示，這次升息不只是預防性措施。歐洲通膨前景在夏季期間已經惡化，不僅供給衝擊增加，需求也愈來愈可能推升物價，因此ECB可能必須把利率調至具有限制性的水準，現階段不能排除繼續升息。

成長風險逐漸浮現 市場押注3%恐怕過頭

施羅德(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees則持較審慎看法。他指出，能源價格上漲將使整體通膨維持高檔，但核心通膨目前仍受控制，內需也正在轉弱；能源與融資成本同步上升，可能進一步壓抑歐元區經濟，2027年受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
Rees認為，儘管ECB聲明及經濟預測偏向鷹派，但再次升息的門檻仍高，本次行動更像本輪最後一次升息，而非長期升息周期的起點。除非經濟成長與通膨再次顯著加速，市場不應直接認定利率將朝3%邁進。
Quilter Cheviot固定收益研究主管Richard Carter表示，ECB面臨的平衡難題愈來愈棘手。歐元區部分地區成長仍然脆弱，決策官員必須在抑制通膨與避免進一步打擊經濟之間權衡。停滯性通膨雖尚未成為基本情境，但成長轉弱與通膨壓力重燃的組合，已愈來愈難以忽視。
Aviva Investors利率主管Ed Hutchings認為，ECB眼前首要任務確實是控制通膨，因此市場預期還會升息並非沒有道理。不過，在ECB已升息兩次、市場又反映超過兩次後續升息的情況下，投資人的緊縮押注可能已走得太遠。
富達國際(Fidelity International)歐元區經濟學家Conor Parle則提醒，天然氣及燃料價格上漲將促使ECB密切觀察物價壓力是否擴散。近期熱浪及供應鏈影響可能推高食品通膨，薪資追蹤指標也顯示薪資成長略微加速，決策官員將關注是否出現能源衝擊擴散至其他價格的早期跡象。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) on Thursday (the 10th) raised rates as expected by one quarter-point (25 basis points), lifting the deposit rate to 2.5%, marking its second hike this year to counter inflation pressure from higher energy prices driven by the US‑Iran war. The ECB did not pledge further action, and analysts are divided on whether this round of tightening is near its end: some think another hike could come before year‑end, while others warn that the energy shock will eventually drag down growth and that markets may be over‑betting on rates approaching 3%.

In market reaction, the euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to about $1.159, euro‑area sovereign yields rose to multi‑year highs, the European Stoxx 600 slipped 0.7%, and oil surged more than 4% to $105.3 a barrel.

Hawkish voices say the tightening is not over and another move may come before year‑end. Deutsche Bank (DB‑US) chief European economist Mark Wall said inflation risks are rising and the odds that the ECB will hike again in December may now exceed the odds of holding steady. Still, the ECB must act cautiously because, although the euro‑area economy has shown resilience over the past six months, the negative supply shock from rapidly rising natural‑gas prices is accumulating and will eventually hurt growth; the question is how severe and when it will materialise.

Saltmarsh Economics European economist Marchel Alexandrovich noted that the ECB’s second hike within three months hints that further tightening may be needed in upcoming meetings. While the ECB has not pre‑committed to more hikes, its latest forecasts show core inflation still at 2.3% in 2028, up from a June estimate of 2.2%, implying that bringing inflation back to the 2% target in the medium term may still require additional rate rises.

JPMorgan Private Bank (JPM‑US) macro investment strategist Patrick Ernst said a rate hike before year‑end is no longer a low‑probability risk. The renewed escalation of the Middle‑East conflict has pushed oil and gas prices sharply higher, U.S. Treasuries have been sold off, and market expectations for continued tightening by major central banks have risen in tandem.

Ernst added that the ECB’s move was in line with expectations, but the crucial point is that the policy statement still leaves room for further tightening, showing that inflation risks from energy remain. “This hike is not a ceiling on rates,” he said, and the path forward will depend heavily on geopolitical developments.

S&P Global Ratings (SPGI‑US) Europe, Middle East and Africa chief economist Sylvain Broyer also said the hike is more than a precautionary step. Europe’s inflation outlook worsened over the summer, with both supply shocks intensifying and demand increasingly likely to push prices up, so the ECB may have to lift rates to a restrictive level and cannot rule out further hikes at this stage.

Schroders global economics head David Rees took a more cautious view. He noted that higher energy prices will keep overall inflation elevated, but core inflation is still under control and domestic demand is weakening; the simultaneous rise in energy costs and financing costs could further suppress euro‑area growth, with the impact especially pronounced in 2027.

Rees argued that although the ECB’s statement and forecasts lean hawkish, the threshold for another hike remains high, and this move looks more like the last hike of the current cycle rather than the start of a prolonged tightening period. Unless growth and inflation accelerate markedly again, markets should not assume rates will march toward 3%.

Quilter Cheviot fixed‑income research head Richard Carter said the ECB’s balancing act is becoming increasingly tricky. Growth remains fragile in parts of the euro area, and policymakers must weigh curbing inflation against avoiding further damage to the economy. Stagnating inflation has not yet become a baseline scenario, but the combination of weakening growth and rekindling inflation pressures is becoming harder to ignore.

Aviva Investors rates head Ed Hutchings said the ECB’s immediate priority is indeed to rein in inflation, so market expectations of further hikes are not unfounded. However, after two hikes already and market pricing in more than two additional moves, investors’ tightening bets may have gone too far.

Fidelity International euro‑area economist Conor Parle warned that rising natural‑gas and fuel prices will make the ECB watch closely for any spread of price pressures. Recent heatwaves and supply‑chain issues could lift food inflation, and wage‑tracking indicators show a slight acceleration in pay growth, prompting policymakers to watch for early signs that the energy shock is spilling over into other price categories.

items.title: 〈台幣〉買匯力道轉強 貶值4.3分收在31.548元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar Buying Pressure Strengthens, Depreciates 4.3 Cents to Close at 31.548
paras: 新台幣今(10)日升貶互見，午盤過後貶勢擴大，終場收在31.548元，貶值4.3分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值放大至19.39億美元。
